title: Motion Graphics Designer
description:
Role Summary
To creatively and professionally design and produce graphic, visual, and audio content to support advertising and information campaigns and enhance the public image of DABS

Duties and Responsibilities
Graphic and Advertising Design
Create diverse, high-quality motion-graphic visual and audio advertisements in accordance with DABS requirements
Design visual content for publications and topics in graphic formats
Design animated titles and subtitles
3 D Design and Animation
Production of Standardized Content
Prepare charts, animations, and high-quality video clips for use on DABS digital platforms and official media channels
Ensure compliance with the organization’s visual identity
Creativity and Concept Development
Develop creative ideas and concepts and apply them to graphic design and production projects
Animate graphic elements
Design content that attracts electricity consumers’ attention and promotes a positive culture of electricity use
Preparation and Editing of Graphic Materials
Prepare professional design materials and revise/edit materials assigned by management or other departments
Audio and Media Equipment Setup
Be responsible for configuring audio, audio mixers, and recording equipment for the production of advertising materials
Assist with the playback of audio and video advertisements at official meetings and gatherings
Photography and Videography
Carry out photography and videography duties when required and when the relevant staff member is unavailable
Design of Printed Materials
Professionally and systematically design the company’s brochures, yearbooks, manuals, reports, calendars, magazines, annual reports, and printed booklets
Other Duties
Perform other assigned duties related to achieving the organization’s objectives, as delegated by the supervisor and the Publications Manager
Respect administrative principles and observe the chain of command

Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Journalism or Computer Science
Three years of work experience in the media sector, in the private or public sector
Required computer skills, including Microsoft and Adobe applications, and the ability to learn new software packages
Full proficiency in graphic design software, such as:
Adobe Photoshop
Adobe Illustrator
Adobe InDesign
Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects for video and animation work
Familiarity with audio software such as Audition for audio setup, editing, and mixing
Ability to use a camera professionally for photography and videography
Full speaking and writing proficiency in the country’s official languages

title: IT & Western Union Assistant for Helmand Branch
description:
Role Summary
The Branch IT + Western Union (WU) Assistant is responsible for providing technical support and assistance with IT systems in the branch, ensuring the efficient operation of banking technology. Additionally, this role encompasses managing Western Union transactions and services, providing exceptional customer service, and ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures.

Duties and Responsibilities
Key Duties and Responsibilities:
IT Support
Technical Assistance
Provide day-to-day technical support for all banking software and hardware used within the branch.
Troubleshoot and resolve hardware and software issues, ensuring minimal disruption to branch operations.
Branch IT related Items Maintenance
Assist in the maintenance and updating of branch IT systems, including computers, networks, and hardware’s.
Ensure that all IT equipment is functioning properly and coordinate with external vendors for repairs as needed.
Provide services to branch all IT items at least twice in a month
User Training
Train branch staff on the use of banking software, equipment, and IT best practices to enhance their operational efficiency.
Develop user guides and training materials for specific IT processes as required.
Data Security
Assist in monitoring and implementing security measures to protect branch IT systems and customer data.
Ensure compliance with data protection policies and procedures.
Reporting
Maintain accurate records of service requests and IT incidents, providing reports to the Branch Manager and IT Department as needed.
WU (Western Union) Operations
Transaction Processing
Manage and process Western Union transactions including Send and receive, ensuring that all transactions comply with WU policy and procedure.
Assist customers with inquiries related to Western Union services, providing accurate information and resolving any issues that arise.
Customer Service
Provide exceptional customer service to clients utilizing Western Union services, ensuring a positive customer experience.
Compliance and Reconciliations
Process all WU transactions as per AML/CFT policy.
Conduct daily basis reconciliation during end of the day.
Prepare and submit reports related to Western Union activities to the Branch Manager.
Compliance
Adhere to all regulatory and compliance requirements related to customer service and banking operations.
Assist with CSO of the branch in daily branch activities.
Punctuality. (Follow official working time schedule properly).
Behave in a professional way with all the colleagues and customers of the branch.
Any other task assigned by Line Manager or will be assigned other duties and responsibilities as may be required to meet the goals and objectives of the bank.

Job Requirements
Education: Bachelor’s degree in BCS and master’s degree is preferred.
Experience: 3 years of experience and previous experience in IT support within a banking or financial services environment is a plus.
Skills and Competencies:
Strong technical skills with proficiency in computer systems, networking, and common software applications.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot technical issues effectively.
Good communication and interpersonal skills, with a strong focus on customer service.
Ability to work collaboratively within a team and manage multiple tasks effectively.
Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
Fluency in Dari, Pashto, and English is required.

Submission Guidelines
Qualified and interested applicants are encouraged to apply online through the BMA Job Portal at https://jobs.bma.com.af before the closing date.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further process.

title: Database and Application Support Associate-ACDMS
description:
Job Summary
Core Functions / Responsibilities:
1. Support the configuration, maintenance and routine enhancement of ACDMS applications and databases. Assist with updates to forms, fields, validation rules, reports and other system components in accordance with approved specifications and established procedures.
2. Support data import, migration, validation and quality-control activities. Conduct routine checks for completeness, consistency and accuracy of data, document findings and escalate unresolved issues as required.
3. Conduct assigned system testing activities, including functional, integration and user acceptance testing, in accordance with approved test cases and procedures. Assist with routine application and database maintenance, performance monitoring and implementation of approved system updates.
4. Provide first-line support to ACDMS users by responding to routine inquiries, assisting with user onboarding and training activities, and escalating complex or non-routine technical issues through established channels.
5. Assist in maintaining dashboards, reports, extracts and data-refresh processes. Verify outputs against approved definitions and report discrepancies or system issues.
6. Maintain technical documentation, user guides, issue logs, test records and configuration inventories. Follow approved version-control and change-management procedures.
7. Support user account administration and access management processes. Follow IOM data protection, information security, confidentiality and records-management requirements and report any suspected incidents or risks through established channels.
8. Work closely with the Senior Database and Developer Associate – ACDMS, National Information Management and Database Officer – ACDMS, Database and Information Management Officer, ICT colleagues and programme focal points to carry out assigned support tasks and contribute to the effective day-to-day operation of ACDMS.
9. Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.
Required Qualifications and Experience
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Development, Database Administration or a related field from an accredited academic institution with three years of relevant professional experience;
Or
High School diploma with five years of relevant professional experience.
Experience
Experience providing application, database, data-management or information-technology support;
Experience using relational databases and SQL for routine queries, validation, reporting or data maintenance;
Experience supporting web-based applications or undertaking basic development, scripting or configuration tasks;
Experience conducting software testing, documenting defects and verifying corrections;
Experience cleaning, mapping, importing, validating or reconciling data;
Experience providing user support, recording incidents and escalating complex technical issues;
Experience maintaining technical documentation, user guidance, issue logs or configuration records;
Experience with version-control, ticketing or change-management tools is an advantage; and,
Experience with reporting, dashboards or business-intelligence tools is an advantage.
SKILLS
Working knowledge of relational database concepts and SQL;
Basic knowledge of web applications, programming or scripting and the ability to work within established development frameworks;
Ability to perform structured data cleaning, validation, import and reconciliation tasks accurately;
Ability to execute test cases, reproduce problems and document clear technical findings;
Good troubleshooting and user-support skills, including appropriate escalation of complex or sensitive issues;
Familiarity with version control, issue tracking, reporting tools or application-support workflows is an advantage;
Awareness of data protection, confidentiality, access control and information-security principles;
Good organisational, documentation and communication skills; and,
Ability to follow technical instructions, manage assigned tasks and work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
Languages
For all Applicants, fluency in English is required (oral and written).
Working knowledge of Pashto or Dari is required.
Fluency in all national language(s) are highly advantages.

title: National Information Management and Database Officer-ACDMS
description:
Job Summary
Core Functions / Responsibilities:
Coordinate the programme-facing implementation and continuous improvement of ACDMS, in close coordination with the Head of Programmes and Programme Managers, by consolidating programme priorities, preparing implementation roadmaps and workplans in relation to information management portfolio.
Conduct structured requirements gathering with Programme Managers, programme teams and information management focal points; document and validate business processes, user roles, data flows, functional and reporting requirements, acceptance criteria and change requests; and translate agreed needs into clear functional specifications and prioritised product backlogs for the technical team.
Coordinate the implementation and maintenance of ACDMS data governance arrangements, including common data standards, metadata, data dictionaries, master and reference data, beneficiary identification and deduplication rules, data quality controls, access roles, retention requirements and auditability, in accordance with IOM data protection principles, information security requirements and applicable institutional policies.
Coordinate the configuration, testing, rollout and operational use of common and programme-specific ACDMS modules, including beneficiary and service records, project management, document management, referrals and case management, needs and assessments, monitoring and evaluation, audit and related reporting functions; facilitate appropriate data migration and interoperability with existing systems and approved external interfaces.
Establish and coordinate user acceptance testing, data validation and release-readiness processes; ensure that defects, security or privacy concerns and gaps against approved requirements are recorded, prioritised and addressed in coordination with relevant technical teams; and maintain traceable approvals from the relevant programme owners before deployment of substantive changes.
Work with Programme Managers, reporting, analysis, visualisation, GIS and database colleagues to coordinate the development and delivery of reliable, timely and appropriately disaggregated information products, dashboards and cross-programme insights, with documented definitions and access controls, for operational management, programme monitoring, donor reporting and senior management decision-making.
Coordinate the development and implementation of an ACDMS adoption and capacity-building plan; coordinate user onboarding, guidance materials, standard operating procedures, training and support mechanisms; monitor system use and user feedback; and promote consistent application of approved workflows and standards across programmes and field locations.
Supervise assigned ACDMS personnel in accordance with the approved structure; set objectives, allocate work, review outputs and support staff development; maintain programme-facing system documentation, decision logs, inventories and handover materials; and promote collaborative working arrangements across the technical team and programme focal points.
Under the technical supervision of the Database and Information Management Officer, coordinate programme input into system architecture, database standards, interoperability, user access management, data governance, information security requirements, quality assurance protocols and technical roadmaps. Facilitate the review of ACDMS enhancements, new modules and integrations against approved information management standards and institutional policies before deployment.
Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.

title: National Specialist – M&E (MERL - Quantitative Research)
category: MEAL (Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning), Monitoring & Reporting
description:
Role Summary
POSITION OBJECTIVE
The incumbent will contribute to guiding M&E and MERL in high-quality survey sampling, research instrument design, statistical analysis, and also delivering training in quantitative research methods. The Quantitative Research Specialist, together with the M&E coordinator, will coordinate data collection in a wide range of multi-disciplinary areas using a set of common standards and data management practices. This will then allow data to be reused by other projects in the future, as well as providing the data for a wider audience across the AKDN network. She/he will also support the R&D pillar of MERL in the design, implementation, data management, analysis, reporting, and dissemination of outcome-level studies, such as Quality-of-Life study.
The position for the job holder will be funded by more than one grant, and s/he should expect to work on more than one project or program at any one time. Additionally, the job holder may spend up to approximately 80% of her/his working time focusing on research and evaluation, but up to 20% on a second area (e.g., Monitoring and MIS). This is to ensure that the Unit and its staff are flexible and can adapt as funding and programs change; and it ensures that MERL staff have a broad and professional understanding of MERL, which will enable them to progress their career within AKF-A. Where individuals wish to specialize, this will also be supported. The position holder is also supposed to apply the 70:20:10 capacity building model in their work, where 70% of learning will be on-the-job learning, while 20% will be through planned capacity building opportunities within MERL, as well as 10% through specific training programs for the career development of individuals.

Duties and Responsibilities
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 Technical Support
• To develop common standards and practices related to quantitative research data collection.
• Prepare questionnaires and data collection formats and tools and to conduct field studies in AKDN programming areas.
• To do quantitative research survey methodology, sample selection, data cleaning, and analysis of survey results using any of these apps: SPSS, R, Stata, CSpro, or Python.
• Prepare presentations, brochures, and other technical documents from the outcome of the research for publication purposes.
• Actively monitor and analyze secondary data and trends from internal and external sources, academic research, and reports to inform and improve development programming.
• Present and communicate research and analysis clearly and effectively across various organizations in any format required.
• To design data entry forms in CSPro, Kobo Toolbox, ONA, or MS Access for data collection and entry.
• Serve as a technical resource person for MERL teams working in the regions.
• Undertake monitoring visits and evaluations of quantitative research-nature development projects.
• Train MERL staff in specialized procedures and theoretical concepts and analyze and interpret the results of surveys.
• Explore and recommend alternative approaches to improve the quality of research findings.
• To write comprehensive reports on the findings of the research and evaluation projects in collaboration with M&E/R/&D teams.
• To verify that the information on databases remains available, safe, and secure.
To participate proactively in knowledge uptake/community of practice and other learning platforms across AKDN networks.
 Planning
• Design relevant quantitative research methods for various studies and assessments under different projects as needed.
• In coordination with others in M&E/R&D teams, prepare work plans (monthly, quarterly, and yearly) and implement capacity building interventions for MERL officers in the regions.
• Regularly review and reflect upon the field monitoring reports, case studies and success stories conducted at the regions, and work of the 3rd parties contracted out by AKF-A.
 Reporting and updates
• Contribute to the development and compilation of the integrated data management system (IDMS), including the regular updates of project documents, PMFs, LFAs, and others as assigned.
• Contribute to the design, implementation, update, and reporting of project M&E plans.
• Provide high-quality research and evaluation reports in a timely manner.
 Representation
• Represent MERL in all M&E/R&D works across the AKDN network with professionalism and in partnership with other colleagues.
• Represent MERL at meetings, events/campaigns, and other national conferences and workshops.
• To carry out responsibilities of the role in a way which reflects AKF’s commitment to protecting children and vulnerable adults in accordance with the Safeguarding Policy and Child Safeguarding Policy.
• To report any suspicions or actual violations of the Safeguarding Policy and and/or Child Safeguarding Policy as per the given training.
OCCASIONAL SIGNIFICANT DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Any tasks assigned by the immediate supervisor or MERL senior management.
DECISION-MAKING & AUTHORITY
 Administration
• Coordination of M&E/R&D activities.

title: National Specialist – M&E (MERL - Quantitative Research)
description:
Job Summary
POSITION OBJECTIVE
The incumbent will contribute to guiding M&E and MERL in high-quality survey sampling, research instrument design, statistical analysis, and also delivering training in quantitative research methods. The Quantitative Research Specialist, together with the M&E coordinator, will coordinate data collection in a wide range of multi-disciplinary areas using a set of common standards and data management practices. This will then allow data to be reused by other projects in the future, as well as providing the data for a wider audience across the AKDN network. She/he will also support the R&D pillar of MERL in the design, implementation, data management, analysis, reporting, and dissemination of outcome-level studies, such as Quality-of-Life study.
The position for the job holder will be funded by more than one grant, and s/he should expect to work on more than one project or program at any one time. Additionally, the job holder may spend up to approximately 80% of her/his working time focusing on research and evaluation, but up to 20% on a second area (e.g., Monitoring and MIS). This is to ensure that the Unit and its staff are flexible and can adapt as funding and programs change; and it ensures that MERL staff have a broad and professional understanding of MERL, which will enable them to progress their career within AKF-A. Where individuals wish to specialize, this will also be supported. The position holder is also supposed to apply the 70:20:10 capacity building model in their work, where 70% of learning will be on-the-job learning, while 20% will be through planned capacity building opportunities within MERL, as well as 10% through specific training programs for the career development of individuals.
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Prepare presentations, brochures, and other technical documents from the outcome of the research for publication purposes.

• To design data entry forms in CSPro, Kobo Toolbox, ONA, or MS Access for data collection and entry.

To participate proactively in knowledge uptake/community of practice and other learning platforms across AKDN networks.

• Contribute to the development and compilation of the integrated data management system (IDMS), including the regular updates of project documents, PMFs, LFAs, and others as assigned.

• Provide high-quality research and evaluation reports in a timely manner.

• Represent MERL in all M&E/R&D works across the AKDN network with professionalism and in partnership with other colleagues.

title: Senior Database and Software Developer Associate- ACDMS
description:
Job Summary
Core Functions / Responsibilities:
1. Develop, configure, maintain and support in the design of relational database structures, schemas, tables, views, functions, procedures and data models required for ACDMS modules. Apply approved naming conventions, data dictionaries, metadata and reference-data standards, and maintain technical consistency across development, testing and production environments.
2. Lead the configuration, maintainance and enhancement of secure web-based ACDMS applications and modules in accordance with approved functional and technical specifications to produce clean, documented and maintainable code, resolve defects, implement approved changes and steer controlled application upgrades and releases.
3. Develop and maintain approved application programming interfaces, data exchange services and integration routines connecting ACDMS modules with authorised internal or external systems. Conduct secure data migration, import, export, synchronisation and transformation processes with validation and reconciliation of migrated data.
4. Administer application source code, database scripts and related technical assets in approved version-control repositories applying agreed branching, peer-review, change-control, build and deployment practices, and maintain traceability between releases, approved requirements, test results and technical documentation.
5. Analyse and optimise database queries, application components and reporting processes to improve performance, reliability and scalability. Undertake routine technical maintenance, identify emerging capacity or performance issues, and recommend technical improvements or implement approved corrective actions in coordination with the Database and Information Management Officer and ICT.
6. Implement and verify approved authentication, authorisation, role-based access, encryption, logging and audit-control requirements, apply secure coding and database practices, promptly document and escalate identified vulnerabilities or privacy risks, to uphold technical compliance with IOM information security and data protection requirements.
7. Prepare and conduct unit, integration, regression, performance and technical tests, document results and defects, support user acceptance testing led by the National Information Management and Database Officer – ACDMS, and verify approved acceptance criteria and release-readiness requirements before deployment.
8. Build and maintain approved automated reports, extracts, data services, dashboards and interfaces with business-intelligence or visualisation tools, document calculations, filters, data refresh routines and technical definitions, and align them with validated programme and information management requirements
9. Implement and test approved backup, restoration, disaster-recovery and business-continuity arrangements for ACDMS databases and applications, and maintain configuration records and technical recovery documentation in coordination with ICT and the Database and Information Management Officer.
10. Provide second-line technical support for ACDMS, diagnose and resolve application, database, integration and performance incidents, maintain clear incident and change records, and escalate issues requiring infrastructure, security, vendor or management action through the established channels.
11. Maintain and develop system architecture records, database diagrams, data models, API documentation, deployment instructions, configuration registers, release notes, code documentation and troubleshooting guides to facilitate structured knowledge transfer to other technical personnel and contribute to relevant technical training and user guidance.
12. Coordinate day-to-day technical work with the direct supervisor, the Database and Information Management Officer, ICT and assigned developers or assistants, provide technical guidance, code and database review, assign technical tasks, review outputs and support knowledge transfer and technical development of assigned personnel to foster aligned, quality-assured technical delivery and developed team capability.
13. Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.
Required Qualifications and Experience
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Database Administration or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience;
Or
High School diploma with seven years of relevant professional experience.
Experience
Progressively responsible experience in database design, software or web application development, systems integration and technical support;
Experience developing and maintaining web-based applications using one or more established server-side and client-side programming languages or frameworks;
Experience developing or consuming RESTful APIs, web services or other data-integration mechanisms;
Experience using version-control platforms and structured software development, testing, release and change-management practices;
Experience implementing authentication, authorisation, role-based access, logging and other application or database security controls;
Experience with data migration, data validation, performance tuning, troubleshooting and production support; and,
Experience developing automated reports, dashboards or data services for business-intelligence and visualisation platforms is an advantage.
SKILLS
Advanced working knowledge of relational database concepts and SQL; experience with PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL or comparable platforms;
Proficiency in at least one relevant application-development stack, such as .NET, Java, PHP, Python or a comparable server-side framework, together with JavaScript or a comparable client-side technology;
Knowledge of API design, systems integration, data transformation and structured interchange formats;
Working knowledge of Git or a comparable version-control system and collaborative development workflows;
Ability to interpret approved business and functional requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions;
Knowledge of secure coding, database security, access control, audit logging, data protection and information-security principles;
Ability to diagnose complex technical problems, document findings and implement reliable solutions in a controlled environment;
Good technical writing, communication, planning and knowledge-transfer skills; and,
Ability to work collaboratively with programme, information management and ICT colleagues while maintaining clear technical accountability.
Languages

Fluency in all national language(s) are highly advantages.

title: Senior Database and Software Developer Associate – ACDMS
description:
Job Description
Under the overall supervision of the Senior Programme Coordinator (DTM) and the direct supervision of the National Information Management and Database Officer – ACDMS, and the technical supervision of the Database and Information Management Officer, the Senior Database and Software Developer Associate – ACDMS will be responsible and accountable for being the technical focal point for the database and application layers of the Afghanistan Centralised Database Management System (ACDMS). The role will support in the development, maintenance, integration, performance and operational reliability of the system. The incumbent will work closely with the ACDMS team, programme information management focal points, Information and Communications Technology (ICT) and other relevant units, and will work within agreed priorities and escalates only policy, strategic or exceptional matters.
ACDMS is a Country Office (CO)-wide institutional data management initiative intended to provide a centrally governed, secure, scalable and interoperable platform supporting beneficiary and service records, programme and project management, document management, referrals and case management, needs and assessments, monitoring and evaluation, audit functions, reporting and analysis. The platform is intended to reduce fragmented systems and duplication while strengthening data quality, accountability, information security and evidence-informed decision-making.
The position will translate approved functional specifications into reliable database structures, application components, Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), integrations, automated reports and technical documentation. Programme ownership, business-rule validation and prioritisation remain with the relevant programme management structures, while technical architecture, database standards and information management compliance will be guided by the Database and Information Management Officer.
Responsibilities
1.Develop, configure, maintain and support in the design of relational database structures, schemas, tables, views, functions, procedures and data models required for ACDMS modules. Apply approved naming conventions, data dictionaries, metadata and reference-data standards, and maintain technical consistency across development, testing and production environments.
2.Lead the configuration, maintainance and enhancement of secure web-based ACDMS applications and modules in accordance with approved functional and technical specifications to produce clean, documented and maintainable code, resolve defects, implement approved changes and steer controlled application upgrades and releases.
3.Develop and maintain approved application programming interfaces, data exchange services and integration routines connecting ACDMS modules with authorised internal or external systems. Conduct secure data migration, import, export, synchronisation and transformation processes with validation and reconciliation of migrated data.
4.Administer application source code, database scripts and related technical assets in approved version-control repositories applying agreed branching, peer-review, change-control, build and deployment practices, and maintain traceability between releases, approved requirements, test results and technical documentation.timise database queries, application components and reporting processes to improve performance, reliability and scalability. Undertake routine technical maintenance, identify emerging capacity or performance issues, and recommend technical improvements or implement approved corrective actions in coordination with the Database and Information Management Officer and ICT.
6.Implement and verify approved authentication, authorisation, role-based access, encryption, logging and audit-control requirements, apply secure coding and database practices, promptly document and escalate identified vulnerabilities or privacy risks, to uphold technical compliance with IOM information security and data protection requirements.
7.Prepare and conduct unit, integration, regression, performance and technical tests, document results and defects, support user acceptance testing led by the National Information Management and Database Officer – ACDMS, and verify approved acceptance criteria and release-readiness requirements before deployment.
8.Build and maintain approved automated reports, extracts, data services, dashboards and interfaces with business-intelligence or visualisation tools, document calculations, filters, data refresh routines and technical definitions, and align them with validated programme and information management requirements
9.Implement and test approved backup, restoration, disaster-recovery and business-continuity arrangements for ACDMS databases and applications, and maintain configuration records and technical recovery documentation in coordination with ICT and the Database and Information Management Officer.
10.Provide second-line technical support for ACDMS, diagnose and resolve application, database, integration and performance incidents, maintain clear incident and change records, and escalate issues requiring infrastructure, security, vendor or management action through the established channels.
11.Maintain and develop system architecture records, database diagrams, data models, API documentation, deployment instructions, configuration registers, release notes, code documentation and troubleshooting guides to facilitate structured knowledge transfer to other technical personnel and contribute to relevant technical training and user guidance.12.
Coordinate day-to-day technical work with the direct supervisor, the Database and Information Management Officer, ICT and assigned developers or assistants, provide technical guidance, code and database review, assign technical tasks, review outputs and support knowledge transfer and technical development of assigned personnel to foster aligned, quality-assured technical delivery and developed team capability.
13.Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.
Qualifications
EDUCATION
•Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Database Administration or a related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience; or,
•High School diploma with seven years of relevant professional experience.
EXPERIENCE
Progressively responsible experience in database design, software or web application development, systems integration and technical support;
Experience developing and maintaining web-based applications using one or more established server-side and client-side programming languages or frameworks;
Experience developing or consuming RESTful APIs, web services or other data-integration mechanisms;
Experience using version-control platforms and structured software development, testing, release and change-management practices;
Experience implementing authentication, authorisation, role-based access, logging and other application or database security controls;
Experience with data migration, data validation, performance tuning, troubleshooting and production support; and,
Experience developing automated reports, dashboards or data services for business-intelligence and visualisation platforms is an advantage.
Required Skills

title: Senior Information Management Associate – ACDMS
description:
Job Description
Under the overall supervision of the Senior Programme Coordinator (DTM) and the direct supervision of the National Information Management and Database Officer – ACDMS, and the technical supervision of the Database and Information Management Officer, the Senior Information Management Associate – ACDMS will be responsible for supporting the operationalisation of the Afghanistan Centralised Database Management System (ACDMS) across multiple IOM programmes. The incumbent will work in close coordination with Programme Managers, designated programme focal points, field offices and field staff to support the complete, timely, accurate and consistent collection, validation, submission and maintenance of programme data in ACDMS.
ACDMS is a Country Office (CO)-wide institutional data management initiative intended to provide a centrally governed, secure and interoperable platform supporting programme implementation, beneficiary and service records, referrals and case management, assessments, monitoring and
evaluation, reporting and analysis. The position will serve as an operational information management link between programme and field teams and the wider ACDMS team, helping translate approved programme workflows and data requirements into consistent day-to-day data management practices.
The incumbent will support several programmes rather than a single project portfolio and will independently follow up routine data-quality, reporting and system-use issues within established procedures, referring complex technical, data-protection or programme matters to the appropriate colleagues.
Responsibilities
Support the implementation of information management processes and approved ACDMS workflows across multiple programmes. Coordinate with programme focal points, field offices and relevant stakeholders on the timely and accurate collection, validation, submission, management and reporting of programme data.
Monitor data flows into ACDMS and conduct routine data quality checks for completeness, consistency, accuracy and compliance with approved standards and procedures. Identify and document discrepancies and follow up with programme and field teams to address identified data issues, and refer complex or recurring issues to the supervisor or relevant technical colleagues.
Maintain regular coordination with Programme Managers, programme focal points, field offices and field staff to support data management activities, reporting requirements and implementation of approved information management procedures.
Support programme teams in the use of ACDMS modules, forms and workflows. Provide first-line functional support to users, facilitate onboarding and training, and escalate technical issues to the appropriate ACDMS team members.
Support the preparation of reports, dashboards, data summaries and other information products using validated programme data. Review data and outputs for completeness and consistency with approved indicators, definitions and reporting requirements.
Maintain data management documentation, reporting trackers, validation records and issue logs. Apply established IOM data-protection, information-security, confidentiality and records-management requirements in the handling and documentation of programme data, and refer potential compliance concerns through the appropriate channels.
Coordinate closely with other Information Management Associates, programme focal points and ACDMS team members, including database, reporting, analysis, visualisation and GIS colleagues, to support the consistent implementation of information management standards and practices.
Identify and document recurring data-management challenges and contribute practical suggestions for improving workflows, tools, validation checks, user guidance and training materials, for consideration by the supervisor and relevant technical colleagues.
Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.
Qualifications
EDUCATION
• Bachelor’s degree in Information Management, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Social Sciences, Business Administration or a related field from an accredited academic institution with four years of relevant professional experience; or
• High School diploma with six years of relevant professional experience.
EXPERIENCE
• Experience supporting information management, programme monitoring, database or management information system processes in operational settings;
• Experience coordinating data collection, submission, verification and correction with programme focal points and field teams;
• Experience conducting data-quality checks and working with structured datasets, indicators, reference data and reporting schedules;
• Experience supporting users of web-based data systems, programme databases or digital data-collection tools;
• Experience producing data summaries, routine reports, dashboards or information products from validated data;
• Experience documenting data flows, procedures, business rules, issue logs or standard operating procedures;
• Experience supporting training, user onboarding or field-level technical guidance; and,
• Experience working across several programmes or operational portfolios is an advantage.
Required Skills

title: Senior Visualisation Associate – ACDMS
description:
Job Description
Under the overall supervision of the Senior Programme Coordinator (DTM), the direct supervision of the Data Analysis and Visualisation Officer and in close coordination with the Database and Information Management Officer, the Head of Programmes and Programme Managers, the Senior Visualisation Associate – ACDMS will be responsible for supporting the development and maintenance of a unified dashboard ecosystem across IOM Afghanistan programmes, applying approved analytical, visualisation and information-management standards. The position will support the reduction of duplication and standardisation of visualisation approaches; develop and maintain ACDMS dashboards; and support the implementation and maintenance of approved Country Office (CO)-wide dashboard visual identity standards, in alignment with information products produced by Displacement Tracking Matirx (DTM) and the wider Information Management Unit.
ACDMS is a Country Office (CO)-wide institutional data management initiative intended to establish a centrally governed, secure, scalable and interoperable platform that harmonises programme data
standards and supports consistent data collection, validation, case and referral workflows, reporting, analysis, coordination, oversight and evidence-informed decision-making. The system is designed to reduce fragmentation and duplication, strengthen data quality and accountability, and enable programme-specific modules within a common architecture and governance framework.
Responsibilities
Lead dashboard harmonisation and consolidation across programme portfolios, promoting consistency in the application of approved indicators, definitions, structures and visualisation approaches, in coordination with relevant programme and technical counterparts, and contributing to reliable and standardised information products across programmes.
2. Develop, maintain and improve ACDMS dashboards and business intelligence products, with responsibility for the day-to-day technical delivery, functionality, usability, performance and maintenance of assigned dashboards, and make routine technical and design decisions within established standards and requirements.
3. Support the development and maintenance of approved CO-wide dashboard visual identity, branding and design standards, including reusable templates and consistent UX/UI practices, in coordination with the Data Analysis and Visualisation Officer.
4. Coordinate with Programme Managers and focal points to translate operational requirements into practical visualisation products, clarify requirements and recommend appropriate visualisation solutions within the approved analytical and reporting framework, and support the timely delivery of products that respond to programme needs.
5. Coordinate with the National Information Management and Database Officer – ACDMS to support the alignment of dashboards with approved programme workflows, indicators, definitions and reporting requirements, while identifying and resolving routine data or workflow issues affecting dashboard outputs.
6. Maintain dashboard integration with ACDMS databases, Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and other approved data sources, contributing to stable data refresh, system integration and overall dashboard performance in coordination with the Database and Developer Associate – ACDMS and other ACDMS colleagues.
7. Review indicators, calculations, visualisations and dashboard outputs for consistency, accuracy and quality, and support their compliance with agreed quality-assurance standards and publication requirements.
8. Develop automated visual reporting solutions, executive dashboards and management reporting tools to improve reporting efficiency, accessibility and decision-making, while reducing manual reporting requirements.
9. Support the alignment of ACDMS dashboards with DTM analytical and visualisation standards, working closely with the Data Analysis and Visualisation Officer to apply agreed methodologies, maintain consistency across products, and refer complex analytical or visualisation issues for technical guidance.
10. Provide dashboard user support, onboarding, training and guidance materials, and support users in the appropriate interpretation and use of visualisation products, contributing to effective adoption and use across programme teams.
11. Develop and implement approved dashboard governance arrangements, publication workflows and quality-assurance procedures, including documentation, version control and dashboard inventories, and apply agreed review and publication processes.
12. Promote innovation in business intelligence, visualisation and data storytelling by identifying and applying practical approaches that improve usability, automation and analytical communication, and share relevant good practices across the ACDMS team.
13. Perform such other relevant duties as may be assigned.
Qualifications
EDUCATION
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Visualisation, Information Management, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, GIS, Economics or related field from an accredited academic institution with five years of relevant professional experience;
or
• High School diploma with seven years of relevant professional experience.
EXPERIENCE
• Experience with Power BI, dashboard development, data modelling, business intelligence, visualisation standards and information products;
• Experience translating programme requirements into dashboards and visualisation products, including quality assurance and maintenance;
• Experience with reporting automation and data integration is an advantage; and,
• Experience supporting humanitarian or development programmes is an advantage.
Required Skills

title: Hourly Paid IT Instructor – UCA
description:
Role Summary
The IT instructor is responsible for delivering high-quality, competency-based programmes in Networking, Cyber Security, and related IT disciplines, aligned with industry standards and professional certification pathways such as CompTIA Network+, CCNA, Security+ and CEH certifications. The position exists to equip learners with the technical knowledge, skills, and professional competencies required for further education, certification, and employment in the IT and cyber security sectors.
The position is responsible for effective instruction, learner assessment, academic support, technical mentoring, and development of relevant course materials and learning resources, while contributing to curriculum development and continuous improvement of programme delivery.
The IT Instructor supports the effective management of networking laboratories and learning technologies, ensuring appropriate, secure, and reliable learning environments.
Working collaboratively with the Learning Centre Coordinator, Students Services Officer, and Manager of Academic Affairs (MAA), the IT Instructor contributes to quality assurance, learner engagement, programme delivery, and continuous improvement, while ensuring compliance with SPCE-UCA policies, safeguarding requirements, and academic standards.

Duties and Responsibilities
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 Teaching and Learning
• Deliver high-quality, competency-based Information Technology programmes in Networking and Cyber Security, aligned with approved curricula and industry standards.
• Design and deliver student-centered, competency-based, and interactive lessons using modern teaching methodologies and educational technologies.
• Develop lesson plans, practical exercises, assessments, learning resources, and instructional materials that meet SPCE academic and quality assurance standards.
• Foster an inclusive and engaging learning environment that promotes digital literacy, problem-solving, critical thinking, teamwork, and practical technical skills.
• Conduct placement tests, midterm examinations, final examinations, practical assessments, and continuous student evaluations.
• Monitor student attendance, academic progress, learning outcomes, and classroom performance, providing academic guidance and timely interventions where required.
• Review and continuously improve course content, instructional materials, and delivery methods based on student feedback and programme evaluations.
• Deliver classroom instruction for no more than 20 academic hours per week, with the total annual teaching workload not exceeding 800 academic hours, in accordance with SPCE-UCA academic workload policy.
• Ensure the delivery of high-quality, learner-centered instruction by applying competency-based and interactive teaching methodologies, with the overall failure rate not exceeding 5% and the learner dropout rate not exceeding 6%, while upholding SPCE-UCA's academic quality standards.
 Programme Administration and Academic Support
• Develop, review, and update the programme Concept Note (CN), curriculum, course syllabi, lesson plans, and instructional materials considering the educational market requirements in coordination with the Learning Centre (LC) Coordinator and the Manager of Academic Affairs (MAA).
• Support student recruitment, application, registration, placement testing, and orientation for Information Technology programmes.
• Coordinate teaching schedules in consultation with the Students Services Officer and Learning Centre (LC) Coordinator.
• Prepare and maintain accurate academic records, including attendance, lesson plans, individual work plans, transcripts, grade reports, timetables, and other required documentation.
• Coordinate communication and follow-up with graduates and alumni of IT.
• Complete administrative, academic planning, learner support, office hours, and other assigned responsibilities for no more than 20 hours per week.
 IT Technical Support and Laboratory Management
• Develop and deliver theoretical and practical training in network fundamentals, network access, IP connectivity, IP services, network security, automation, and enterprise networking aligned with networking programme domains.
• Design and deliver practical laboratory sessions, simulations, configuration exercises, troubleshooting scenarios, and real-world networking projects covering routing, switching, small- and medium-sized network infrastructure, virtualization, and network assurance.
• Train learners in small- and medium-sized network architecture, high availability, redundancy, network virtualization, network monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
• Develop learner competency in network security, device hardening, access control, AAA, security monitoring, threat mitigation, and secure network implementation.
• Introduce network automation and programmability, including APIs, JSON, controller-based networking, SDN, and emerging AI-enabled networking technologies.
• Develop and administer quizzes, practical assessments, assignments, projects, and examinations to evaluate learners’ technical competencies.
• Provide technical guidance and mentoring to learners preparing for networking and cybersecurity certifications.
• Prepare and regularly update training materials, laboratory manuals, presentations, and practical resources in accordance with current technologies, certification domains, and professional standards.
• Conduct at least one formal classroom observation per month, resulting in a minimum of 12 documented classroom observations annually, and implement recommendations for continuous instructional improvement.
 Professional Development and Institutional Responsibilities
• Maintain the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, confidentiality, and ethical conduct.
• Participate actively in staff meetings, institutional events, professional development activities, and quality improvement initiatives.
• Perform all duties in compliance with SPCE-UCA and AKF policies, procedures, the Code of Conduct, and the Child Safeguarding Policy, and undertake any other duties assigned by the supervisor.
• To carry out responsibilities of the role in a way which reflects AKF’s commitment to protecting children and vulnerable adults in accordance with the Safeguarding Policy and Child Safeguarding Policy.
• To report any suspicions or actual violations of the Safeguarding Policy and and/or Child Safeguarding Policy as per the given training.
OCCASIONAL SIGNIFICANT DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
• Any tasks assigned by the immediate supervisor.
DECISION-MAKING & AUTHORITY
• N/A

Job Requirements
JOB SPECIFICATION
• Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, specializing in Networking or Cyber Security.
• Professional certifications such as CompTIA Network+, CCNA, CompTIA Security+, CEH, or other recognized networking and cybersecurity certifications are desirable.
• Minimum two years of teaching work experience in networking and cyber security.
• Ability to plan lessons, conduct assessments, prepare reports, and maintain academic records in accordance with SPCE-UCA academic regulations and quality assurance standards.
• Practical experience in design, configuration, administration, troubleshooting, and maintenance of networking infrastructure, routers and switches, wireless networks, firewalls, VPNs, network security solutions, virtualization platforms, network monitoring and analysis tools, network automation technologies, and cyber security laboratory environments is an asset.
• Fluency in Dari and/or Pashto, with a working knowledge of English.
REQUIRED CORE COMPETENCIES
• Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
• Highly motivated with strong organizational skills.
• High level of professionalism, integrity, and accountability.
• Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies and teaching methodologies.
• Strong instructional and facilitation skills.
• Practical demonstration and laboratory management skills.

Submission Guidelines
APPLICATION
Interested applicants should submit their CV along with a cover letter to Jobs.afghanistan@akdn.org no later than 02nd November 2026.
Important Notes:
• Please quote the Vacancy Number as the Subject of the e-mail when applying.
• No supporting documents (e.g., diplomas, recommendation letters, identification card(s), etc.) are required at this stage.
• Only short-listed candidates will be contacted for further assessment.
• Salary scale: Based on the organization’s salary scale.
The Aga Khan Foundation Afghanistan (AKF-Afg) promotes a transparent and equitable recruitment process. We reiterate that all services related to job applications, including processing, seminars, and training programs, are provided free of charge.
Our official job announcements are posted on the ACBAR website (acbar.org/jobs). Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their applications through our designated email address: jobs.afghanistan@akdn.org . Each job vacancy is assigned a unique identification number for your reference, and upon submitting your application, you will receive an automatic confirmation acknowledging its receipt immediately.
AKF- Afg recruitment and selection process reflects our commitment to equal opportunity and protecting children and at-risk adults, beneficiaries, partners, community members, and employees from safeguarding violations. AKF (Afg) participates in the Scheme for the disclosure of safeguarding-related misconduct within the humanitarian and development sector (Misconduct Disclosure Scheme). In line with this Scheme, AKF (Afg) will contact previous employers of job applicants to request information about any investigations or findings of misconduct concerning allegations of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse, and/or sexual harassment (sexual misconduct) against the applicant, during or after their employment. AKF (Afg) further implements a range of procedures and vetting checks, including criminal records disclosures, to ensure everyone associated with AKF (Afg) is kept free from harm and abuse is prevented.
Protection from Sexual Exploitation Abuse and Harassment (PSEAH) is the responsibility of everyone, and all selected individuals will be required to always comply with AKF (Afg)s Safeguarding Policy.
By submitting the job application, the applicant confirms to have understood and consented to AKF (Afg) contacting the applicant’s prior employers, during AKF (Afg)’s recruitment process, to request any such information and maintain this information on file for Recruitment and Human Resources Management purposes.
Female candidates are highly encouraged to apply for this position.

title: Capacity Strengthening Specialist
salary: Salary and conditions are according to ACBAR’s salary scale.
description:
Job Summary
RESPONSIBILITY SUMMARY
ACBAR is hiring a Capacity Strengthening (CS) Specialist to provide direct technical support to national and local NGO’s who request services from ACBAR’s Capacity Strengthening Support Services Team. The CS Specialist will develop tailored support plans to assist NGOs to make improvements based upon specific organizational needs and goals. The CS Specialist will be responsible to work with the NGO’s assigned to their case load, ensuring that they meet the goals of their support plan, demonstrate tangible improvements, make correction as needed when goals are not being met, and conduct follow up assessments to determine how well the capacity support program has been adopted and implemented by the organization.
ACBAR will hire the CS Specialist based upon four key categories of services we will offer to NGOs:
Program Development and Acquisition: The CS Specialist will support NGOs to improve their ability to design and develop new programs, as well as supporting their capacity to write new concept notes and proposals, develop proposal submissions, and engage with donors and funders.
Program Management and Field-Level Implementation: The CS Specialist will support NGOs to improve the implementation of their programs, including developing and following work plans, supporting their ability to technically implement programs in the field, manage budgets, conducting regular monitoring, and provide timely reporting concerning their programs.
Organizational and Operational Capacity: The CS Specialist will support organizations to improve their internal capacity, reviewing and improving current policies, procedures and structure to ensure their organization meets basic practices for operational performance in finance, HR, procurement, logistics, IT/data management, and other key operational areas.
Accountability and Inclusion: The CS Specialist will support organizations to assess how their programs can better reflect the needs of the communities in which the work, particularly for affected populations, and to develop plans to improve how their activities can reach a greater number of people based on their needs.
ESSENTIAL TASKS AND DELIVERABLES
The CS Specialist will be required to fulfill the following tasks:
Develop capacity strengthening support plans for assigned NGO’s who are part of their case load, assessing what needs the organization has based upon specific goals or identified gaps articulated by the organization.
Provide direct mentoring support to national and local NGO’s who request specific capacity strengthening support from ACBAR based upon the agreed upon support plan.
Support the development and implementation of monitoring and assessment tools, as well as programmatic follow-up mechanisms, to assess the impact of project activities.
Working closely with the MEAL team, conduct regular follow up and monitoring visits and engagement with NGOs to gauge the progress of implementing their support plans and to assess the impact of services offered.
Travel to regional offices to support on capacity strengthening service delivery to local NGO’s not based in Kabul based upon the assigned caseload.
Support the development of written reports, success stories and social media pieces that will provide timely updates to ACBAR members, donors, partners and the public on the effectiveness of the services provided.
As requested, support training department activities at the national and sub-national level to ensure integration between capacity strengthening activities and the technical trainings provided to NGO staff members.
Support any other tasks assigned by the direct line manager or the Head of Programs to support the successful implementation of capacity strengthening activities within the program.

Job Requirements
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited academic institution, preferably in humanitarian or development studies, training/education, and/or management or business, Master’s Degree preferred.
Minimum of seven years of progressively responsible experience leading and managing humanitarian or development programs with an international or national NGO. Specific expertise may be either in program implementation or program administration/operations.
The Capacity Strengthening Specialist shall possess demonstrated expertise in data management, digital transformation, and the development of Management Information Systems (MIS) for organizational functions, including Human Resources, Procurement, Monitoring and Evaluation (M&E), and general operations. The Specialist must be highly proficient in the use of Microsoft Excel and Access, including database development, automation, dashboards, reporting, and data analysis, and have proven experience utilizing and recommending appropriate free and premium online platforms, portals, applications, and digital tools to improve organizational efficiency, data quality, reporting, decision-making, and institutional performance.
Specific Experience on at least one of the following:
Program Development and Acquisition: Minimum five years of experience developing new humanitarian and development programs, including experience writing new grant proposals and concept notes, developing key program documents for new programs, and proven experience working and engaging with institutional donors, the UN and other funding sources.
Program Management and Implementation: Minimum five years of experience managing projects at the field level, with proven success at completing project work plans, delivering sound and quality programs with community support, managing administrative requirements of grant implementation, and demonstrated experience monitoring, evaluating and reporting on program implementation.
Organizational and Operational Capacity: Minimum five years of experience managing the internal operational departments of an NGO, with a background including previous work in finance, procurement, administration, etc., with experience in a senior management role preferred. Additionally, the applicant should demonstrate proven experience developing quality internal procedures and policies of an NGO.
Accountability and Inclusion: Minimum five years of experience leading accountability and inclusion for women, girls, people with disability and affected populations within NGO programs, as well as proven experience provide direct supporting engaging community leaders and other community stakeholders for successful program implementation. Knowledge of AAP best practices is preferred.
OTHER REQUIRED SKILLS:
Excellent writing and verbal skills in English, as well as in either Dari or Pashto.
Demonstrated experience supporting national or local NGO partners to improve their capacity through your experience working for NGOs in a specific specialty.
Proven experience developing program documents, operating procedures and manuals, work plans, progress reports, etc. necessary to successfully implement ongoing programs.
Demonstrated ability to be a self-starter and ability to independently manage tasks.
Demonstrated to commitment to accountability, equity and inclusion in leading project teams and program implementation.
Ability and commitment to work well within a team, and willingness to provide support for tasks of other team members that may not fall directly within your job

Submission Guideline
If you possess the necessary qualifications and experience, we invite you to complete the form using the link provided below by November. 03, 2026. Prepare your CV and cover letter as a single file before applying; you will have to attach them.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Notes:
Please be informed that the written test and interview will be conducted only in person.
Job Application Form Link : https://form.acbar.org/app/form?id=RuBNfQ

title: متخصص ارشد نرم افزار
description:
Role Summary
هدف وظیفه :
تحلیل، طراحی، ایجاد، توسعه، آزمایش، استقرار و نگهداری سیستم های معلوماتی تحت ویب و مبایل اپلیکیشن، و مدیریت تیم توسعه نرم‌ افزار و پروژه‌ ها از مرحله تحلیل نیازمندی ‌ها تا بهره ‌برداری نهایی به منظور دیجیتلی‌ سازی خدمات و بهبود موثریت کاری اداره مرکزی و شاروالی ها.

Duties and Responsibilities
وظایف و مسئولیت ها:
وظایف اساسی:.
• تحلیل نیازمندی و طراحی‌ و توسعه سیستم‌ های معلوماتی مطابق معیار های ملی و بین ‌المللی.
• ایجاد، توسعه، نگهداری سیستم ‌های معلوماتی تحت وب (Web Applications).
• ایجاد، توسعه، نگهداری اپلیکیشن‌ های موبایل (Mobile Applications).
• طراحی و توسعه API ها و Web Services جهت ارتباط میان سیستم ‌ها.
• طراحی و توسعه دیتابیس ها و ساختار دیتابیس.
• رفع خطاها و مشکلات نرم‌ افزاری و ارائه راهکار های مناسب.
• انجام Unit Testing، Integration Testing ، System Testing ، User Acceptance Testing (UAT) ،
Performance Testing ، Security Testing و رفع آسیب ‌پذیری ‌های نرم‌ افزاری.
• پیشبرد امور (Git) و رعایت اصول Source Control.
• استقرار (deployment) نرم ‌افزار ها در محیط‌ های Test و Production.
• پیشبرد امور CI/CD و DevOps Processes.
• تهیه و نگهداری مستندات تخنیکی نرم‌افزارها.
• رعایت اصول Secure Coding و Software Development Standards.
• نظارت بر عملکرد سیستم ‌ها و بهینه ‌سازی سرعت و کارایی آن‌ ها.
• تحلیل و رفع مشکلات پیچیده نرم ‌افزار ها و دیتابیس ها.
• طراحی و تطبیق مکانیزم‌ های امنیتی در سیستم‌ های معلوماتی.
• ارائه پیشنهادات تخنیکی برای بهبود سیستم‌های موجود.
• همکاری تخنیکی با بخش شبکه، سرورها، امنیت سایبری و دیتاسنتر در راستای بهره ‌برداری بهتر سیستم ‌ها.
• ارائه مشوره‌ های تخصصی تخنیکی به مدیریت در بخش توسعه سیستم‌ ها و تحول دیجیتلی.
• نظارت بر تمامی پروژه ‌های نرم ‌افزاری و اطمینان از تکمیل آن ‌ها مطابق زمان بندی تعیین شده.
• انجام سایر وظایف مرتبط تخنیکی مطابق هدایت آمر ذیصلاح.
وظایف مدیریتی:
• تشخیص نیاز های آموزشی و ارتقای ظرفیت تیم تخنیکی
• ترتیب، تطبیق و بهبود طرزالعمل‌ها، رهنمود ها و استندرد های توسعه نرم‌افزار.
• مدیریت پروژه‌ های نرم ‌افزاری از مرحله تحلیل الی بهره ‌برداری.
• ترتیب گزارش‌های تخنیکی و مدیریتی و ارائه آن به رئیس مربوطه.
وظایف هماهنگی:
• هماهنگی با تیم توسعه نرم‌ افزار جهت پیشبرد پروژه ‌ها.
• هماهنگی با استفاده کننده گان و بخش‌ های مختلف اداره جهت جمع ‌آوری نیازمندی ‌ها و رفع مشکلات.
• هماهنگی با تیم شبکه، سرور ها و دیتابیس در راستای بهره‌ برداری مؤثر از سیستم‌ ها.
• همکاری با سایر اعضای تیم در طراحی، توسعه، آزمایش و استقرار سیستم ‌ها.

Job Requirements
شرایط استخدام:
• تابعیت افغانستان را داشته باشد.
• سن وی از (18) سال کمتر و از (64) سال بیشتر نباشد.
سویه تحصیلی:
• داشتن حداقل سند تحصیلی لیسانس در یکی از رشته‌ ها: سیستم ‌های معلوماتی، انجنیری نرم‌ افزار یا سایر رشته ‌های مرتبط. به دارندگان سند تحصیلی ماستری در رشته‌ های مرتبط ارجحیت داده می‌ شود.
تجربه کاری:
• حداقل ۷ سال تجربه کاری مرتبط به وظیفه.
• تجربه کاری در سیستم های ملی امتیاز محسوب میشود.
مهارت های لازم:
• مهارت در توسعه نرم ‌افزار های تحت وب با استفاده از ASP.NET Core، Laravel، Spring Boot یا تکنالوژی ‌های مشابه.
• مهارت در توسعه Front-End با استفاده از JavaScript ، React.js، Angular و یا Vue.js.
• مهارت در توسعه Mobile Applications با استفاده از Flutter و یا React Native.
• مهارت در طراحی و توسعه REST API و Web Services.
• مهارت در SQL Server، PostgreSQL و MySQL.
• مهارت در Git و GitHub
• مهارت در Software Testing و Quality Assurance.
• مهارت در DevOps، CI/CD و Software Deployment.
• مهارت در Troubleshooting و Performance Optimization.
• مهارت در Secure Coding و Application Security.
• آشنایی با زبان انگلیسی تخنیکی.
• تسلط به یکی از زبان های رسمی ملی (پشتو یا دری)

Submission Guidelines
Interested candidates are requested to submit their application (CV with the Education Document and Tazkira Scan in one PDF format)
To apply, please Click On Apply Now!
Only complete applications will be accepted, and short-listed candidates will be contacted to interview

title: Manager Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) & Internal Controls Oversight
category: Information Technology, Accounting, Finance, Telecommunication, Business Administration, Risk Management
description:
Role Summary
To lead the establishment, maintenance, and continuous enhancement of the Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) Framework across Etisalat Afghanistan by providing independent risk oversight, challenge, monitoring, reporting, and advisory support to promote effective management of risks within the approved risk appetite. The role serves as a second-line risk oversight function, promoting a strong risk culture and informed decision-making. In addition, the role provides independent oversight of the Internal Controls Framework and coordinates and monitors risk-based control review, testing, and remediation activities in alignment with Etisalat Group requirements.

Duties and Responsibilities
• Lead and coordinate enterprise-wide risk identification, assessment, evaluation, monitoring, and reporting activities covering strategic, operational, financial, regulatory, compliance, fraud, cybersecurity, technology, business continuity, and reputational risks.
• Facilitate periodic risk assessments and Risk C Control Self-Assessments (RCSA) across business functions to identify emerging risks, assess control effectiveness, and evaluate residual risk exposure.
• Maintain the Enterprise Risk Register, ensuring significant risks are appropriately documented, assessed, assigned to risk owners, and supported by mitigation plans.
• Develop, maintain, and monitor risk appetite statements, risk tolerance thresholds, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), and Key Control Indicators (KCIs), and escalate significant breaches and exposures to management.
• Facilitate and oversee the documentation and periodic review of risks, controls, control ownership, testing procedures, and remediation plans for critical business processes.
• Coordinate and oversee the annual Internal Controls Review and Testing Program to assess the design adequacy and operating effectiveness of key controls.
• Identify control deficiencies, process weaknesses, and governance gaps through risk and control assessments, and provide independent recommendations to management to strengthen the effectiveness of the control environment.
• Monitor and report the implementation status of risk mitigation actions, control remediation plans, and risk-related recommendations arising from Internal Audit, External Audit, regulatory reviews, and management assessments.
• Prepare and present periodic risk and internal control reports to the VP Risk C Assurance, Executive Risk Management Committee (ERMC), and the Audit C Risk Management Committee (ARMC), highlighting key risk exposures, emerging risks, control weaknesses, trends, and mitigation progress.
• Collaborate with Internal Audit, Compliance, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, Information Security, Finance, Technology, Human Resources, and business functions to enhance enterprise-wide risk and control management practices.
• Act as Secretary to the Executive Risk Management Committee (ERMC) chaired by the CEO by coordinating meetings, preparing agendas and risk reports, recording minutes, tracking action items, and facilitating timely closure of agreed actions.
• Assess and monitor regulatory and compliance risks and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to support adherence to telecommunications regulations, license obligations, corporate policies, and applicable laws.
• Provide independent oversight of Business Continuity Management (BCM) and Disaster Recovery (DR) testing exercises and monitor implementation of agreed improvement actions.
• Evaluate cybersecurity, information security, data privacy, technology, and network resilience risks in collaboration with relevant stakeholders and ensure such risks are appropriately reflected in the Enterprise Risk Register.
• Provide risk advisory support for strategic initiatives, major projects, investments, new products, digital transformation programs, outsourcing arrangements, and other significant business decisions.
• Promote a strong risk-aware and control-conscious culture through communication, training, awareness initiatives, and stakeholder engagement activities.
• Monitor industry trends, emerging risks, geopolitical developments, regulatory changes, and market conditions that may impact Etisalat Afghanistan's objectives and operations.

Job Requirements
Educational Qualifications:
• Bachelor's Degree in Risk Management, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Telecommunications and Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Preferred:
• Master’s degree in risk management
• Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP)
• Certification in Risk Management Assurance (CRMA)
• Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
• Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
• Financial Risk Manager (FRM)
• ISO 31000 Risk Management Certification
Experience Requirements:
• Minimum 7 years of progressive experience in Enterprise Risk Management, Internal Controls, Compliance, Governance, Risk Advisory, or related disciplines.
• Substantial hands-on experience in Enterprise Risk Management is essential. Experience in Internal Controls, Internal Audit, Compliance, Governance, or Assurance may be considered as complementary experience.
• Minimum 3 to 5 years of experience in a managerial or leadership role - preferred.
• Experience within telecommunications, technology, financial services, or other highly regulated industries is preferred.
• Demonstrated experience in implementing and maintaining Enterprise Risk Management and Internal Control Frameworks.
• Experience in facilitating senior management and Board-level committees and preparing executive and Board reports.
• Strong understanding of risk management frameworks, internal controls, governance, regulatory compliance, business continuity, and operational resilience.
Technical Competencies:
• Enterprise Risk Management (ERM)
• Internal Control Frameworks (COSO)
• ISO 31000 Risk Management
• Governance, Risk C Compliance (GRC)
• Risk Assessment and Analysis
• Risk & Control Self-Assessments (RCSA)
• Internal Controls Testing and Evaluation
• Regulatory Compliance Management
• Operational Risk Management
• Cybersecurity and Technology Risk Management
• Data Analytics and Risk Reporting
• KRI and KCI Development
Behavioral Competencies:
• Strategic Thinking
• Leadership and Stakeholder Management
• Analytical and Critical Thinking
• Decision Making and Problem Solving
• Communication and Presentation Skills
• Influencing and Negotiation Skills
• Planning and Organizing
• Collaboration and Teamwork
• Change Management
• Business Acumen
• Integrity and Professional Ethics
• Results Orientation
• Resilience and Adaptability

Responsible for the operation, administration, security, availability and continuous improvement of ATOMA Microsoft infrastructure, with primary ownership of Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra services, SCCM/WSUS and related enterprise Microsoft platforms.
