· Administer and maintain Windows Server infrastructure and related Microsoft services across Primary and Disaster Recovery Data Centers.
· Administer Active Directory Domain Services, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, LDAP integrations, identity services, trusts, replication and domain health.
· Administer Microsoft 365 services, including Exchange Online, Microsoft Entra ID, authentication, mail flow, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint and tenant-level operational support within approved responsibilities.
· Support Azure services and Microsoft Entra integrations used by ATOMA, including identity synchronization, role-based access and hybrid identity components.
· Administer SCCM/Microsoft Configuration Manager, WSUS, patch management, software deployment, inventory and compliance reporting for Windows servers and approved endpoints.
· Administer Windows infrastructure services including RDS, IIS, DFS/File Services, PKI/Certificate Services, SMTP and related Microsoft server roles.
· Support on-premises Exchange/SMTP services and hybrid mail dependencies where applicable, including troubleshooting of mail flow and certificate-related issues.
· Use PowerShell and approved automation methods to standardize administration, reporting, health checks, user/service operations and repetitive support activities.
· Monitor Microsoft platform availability, capacity, performance, event logs, replication, service health and security status; take corrective action before business impact occurs.
· Implement approved Microsoft security baselines, hardening standards, privileged access controls, patching and remediation actions in coordination with Information Security.
· Manage Microsoft-related SSL/TLS certificates, PKI dependencies, service certificates and renewal/deployment activities in coordination with application and security teams.
· Provide Tier 2/Tier 3 support for major Windows, Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra, SCCM and identity incidents; perform root-cause analysis and preventive actions.
· Administer and support Veeam Backup and Recovery for Windows Server, Active Directory and other Microsoft workloads, including backup jobs, repositories, schedules, retention, monitoring, troubleshooting and restore operations.
· Perform regular backup and restore validation using Veeam and Veritas NetBackup to ensure recoverability of Microsoft infrastructure services.
· Administer and support enterprise Privileged Access Management (PAM) solutions, including PAM360 or equivalent platforms, for secure administrative access to Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft infrastructure and Data Center systems.
· Manage privileged accounts, password vaulting, administrative access policies, session controls and privileged-access audit logs.
· Support Microsoft DNS integration with Pi-hole DNS infrastructure, including conditional forwarding, upstream DNS configuration, name-resolution troubleshooting and coordination with the Linux infrastructure engineer.
· Support VMware vSphere/ESXi/vCenter operations, virtual machine provisioning and troubleshooting as a secondary responsibility and provide cross-coverage to the virtualization team.
· Provide operational support for enterprise Linux servers, storage platforms, backup jobs and Data Center server hardware when required for incident recovery or cross-team coverage.
· Support Dell, HPE and Huawei server platforms, including hardware health monitoring, firmware/driver coordination, warranty troubleshooting and vendor escalation.
· Participate in backup and restore validation using enterprise backup platforms, and ensure Microsoft workloads are protected according to approved backup and retention requirements.
· Participate in Disaster Recovery planning, testing and recovery of Windows, identity, Microsoft 365 integration and supporting infrastructure services.
· Maintain accurate system documentation, build standards, configuration records, architecture diagrams, operational procedures and knowledge-base articles.
· Follow ITIL-aligned incident, problem and change management processes and ensure assigned tickets, changes and actions are documented and closed within agreed service levels.
· Provide 24x7/on-call support when required for critical Microsoft infrastructure incidents, maintenance activities or Data Center/DR operations.

· Education: Bachelor's degree (BCS) in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related field from a reputable university of Afghanistan or abroad.
Experience:
· Minimum 8+ years of relevant experience in Enterprise Infrastructure and Data Center Operations, including hands-on experience in a telecommunications company or telecom service-provider environment. Strong practical experience in Microsoft Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra, SCCM/WSUS and enterprise Microsoft services is required. Experience with VMware, Linux, enterprise storage, backup and server hardware is required for cross-platform support. Experience in supporting 24x7 mission-critical infrastructure and Disaster Recovery operations is required.

title: Internal Audit Senior Officer (IT)
description:
Role Summary
The Internal Audit Senior Officer (IT) is responsible for conducting internal audits and pre-audit compliance reviews to ensure compliance with organizational policies, procedures, applicable laws, and internal control systems. The incumbent initiates, designs, and develops internal audit programs aimed at protecting the company’s assets and resources. You don't wait to be told what to do. You see the gap and you move.
Deadlines don't rattle you. Ambiguity doesn't either.
You're an AI power user, not someone who's "open to learning it someday."
You communicate clearly, especially when things are unclear.
You have opinions and you're not afraid to bring them.
You can laugh at a chaotic week on Friday and mean it.
What we're looking for
3+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, startup or high-growth environment
A hands-on technical background: production code, a bootcamp, or demonstrable ability to navigate a full-stack codebase
Comfortable reading Python and JavaScript/TypeScript; able to write SQL, reason about REST contracts, and follow frontend state
Proven QA ownership: test cases, regression cycles, structured bug reports, release sign-off
Daily fluency with Claude Code or equivalent. Not "open to it." Actually using it.
Strong written communication. Your specs are clear and complete on the first read.
Available in EST
What working here actually looks like
High expectations. Real ownership. Things change fast and we don't apologize for it. You'll work with smart people who push you, a product that keeps getting better, and a team that's genuinely building something new.
The boundary between product and engineering is intentionally blurred here. The best product decisions are inseparable from technical reality, and we hire people who understand that.
We'll probably give you more to own than you expected. That's on purpose.
We use AI every day, across every function. That's just how we work.
What we stand for
We are obsessed with our customers, and making them obsessed with us
We figure it the f**k out
We go to war on our problems quickly
We are strategic. We work smart, not just hard.
We're fun AF

title: Data Clerk
description:
Job description
CTG overview
CTG was established in 2006, almost 20 years ago, in Afghanistan. We currently operate in 35 countries and have approximately 11,500 staff members committed to good!
But do you know who we are? And what do we do?
We provide tailored Human Resources and Staffing Solutions that support critical global initiatives across Humanitarian and Development sectors, and are now strategically foraying into new industries, including Construction, Energy, and IT, with a focus on high-risk regions.
Here’s a list of services we offer:
•Staffing solutions and HR management services
•Monitoring and evaluation
•Fleet management and logistics
•Facilities management
•Sustainability and Communications Advisory
•Election monitoring and observation
•IT professional services
•Medical assistance
Visit www.ctg.org to find out more.
Overview of position
Purpose of the Post:
To ensure accurate collection and management of Polio Eradication Initiative (PEI & EPI) data in the province
Organizational context:
Under the direct supervision of the ARPO/our client Regional Team Lead/Medical Officer Polio and the overall supervision of our client Representative in Afghanistan.
Role objectives
Summary of Assigned Duties: The incumbent will perform the following duties:
Working under direct supervision of the respective Provincial Polio Officer, the incumbent will work in close coordination with the Provincial PEI Manager; the incumbent data clerk will undertake the following duties:
1. Compile all data related to supplementary immunization activities including pre-, intra-, and post-campaign activities.
2. Compile the administrative (reported) coverage and intra-campaign monitoring data of all supplementary immunization activities (OPV and OPV/IPV).
3. Compile and feed forward polio surveillance related data.
4. Validate and clean all the compiled data; and maintain repository of the provincial data.
5. Feed forwards the validated data to the regional and provincial levels as per the program timelines.
6. Any other as assigned by the supervisor.
Functional Skills and
Knowledge:
1. Should have knowledge of administrative and clerical procedures and
systems such as word processing, managing files and records, and other office
procedures.
2. Should be able to work during the campaigns until late hours.
3. Should be able to work independently and in a team.
4. The candidate should have no dual responsibilities and will be FULL time
staff, if recruited.
5. Ability to work harmoniously as a member of a team and adapt to diverse
social and cultural backgrounds.
6. Maintain high standards of personal conduct and integrity.
7. Willingness to work long hours and weekends, especially during important
activities such conferences/meetings, vaccination campaigns, and other
essential events.
Educations:
- Essential : Completion of secondary education (Grade 12)
is required.
- Desirable : Diploma/Degree in Computer Science/IT is highly desirable.
Experience:
Essential:
· At least two years’ experience in data entry, data management, record
keeping, filing, or administrative support.
· Experience entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining data in
electronic databases or Excel spreadsheets.
· Experience checking data for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and
errors.
· Experience maintaining confidentiality and securely handling records
and sensitive information.
Desirable : Relevant experience in the UN/Government/NGO system
Languages : Very good knowledge of English and the local language.
IT : Computer training, particularly in Microsoft Excel,
Word, and data-entry applications.
Project reporting
Under the direct supervision of the ARPO/our client Regional Team Lead/Medical
Officer Polio and the overall supervision of the our client Representative in
Afghanistan.
Key competencies
Competencies:
1. Fostering Integration and Teamwork
2. Communicating in a credible and effective way
3. Knowing and managing your self
Team management
This position does not include team management responsibilities.
Further information
Our client has zero tolerance for sexual misconduct, inaction against it and any form of retaliation against victims/survivors or bystanders who disclose, report, or participate in an investigation. Parallel to technical competence, recruitment, selection and hiring decisions will give due emphasis to assessing candidates value congruence, thorough background checks and reference check processes. This will ensure children and vulnerable adults are safeguarded from abusers and that abusers are prevented from joining our client Afghanistan office. Please report any concerning information regarding sexual exploitation and abuse by our client workforce and partners to our client office of Internal Oversight services at [email protected]
Our client is a smoke free environment.
Disclaimer:
· At no stage of the recruitment process will CTG ask candidates for a fee. This includes during the application stage, interview, assessment and training.
· CTG has a zero tolerance to Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (SEA) which is outlined in its Code of Conduct. Protection from SEA is everyone’s responsibility
· CTG encourages all candidates applying for this advertisement to ensure that their candidate profile is up to date with up to date experience / education / contact details, as this will help you being considered further in your application for this role.

description:
Job Summary
هدف وظیفه: ایجاد، انکشاف، طرح و حمایت تخنیکی سیستم های الکترونیکی ضرورت وزارت مالیه

Job Requirements
وظایف و مسئولیت ها:
وظایف اساسی:
مطالعه و تدقیق پروسه های کاری غرض کد نویسي سیستم ها (دیتابیس ها) و پیشنهاد راه حل جهت رفع موانع و چالش های سیستم های متذکره.
تدوین و تطبیق طرح ها، پروسیجر های جدید کاری، طرز العمل ها و پلان عمل مطابق استراتیژی ریاست تکنالوژی معلوماتی غرض تسریع روند حکومتداری الکترونیکی و ساده سازی پروسه های کاری.
توسعه سیستم ها و ویب سایت ها با درنظر داشت پالیسی های موجود و ویژه گی های مانند: User-friendly, Clean coding, Good UI/UX, Modularity, Performance and flexibility
حصول اطمینان از رفع مشکلات تخنیکی و مصؤنیت سیستم های اداره.
حصول اطمینان از استفادۀ درست و مؤثر از سیستم الکترونیکی اداره به منظور هماهنگی، شفافیت و تسریع پروسۀ کاری و اجراآت لازم طبق هدایت آمر بخش مربوطه.
مطالعه تکنالوژی های جدید و به کار گیری از آنها غرض بروزرسانی و توسعه نرم افزارهای مورد استفاده وزارت مالیه
اشتراک در کنفرانس ها و ورکشاپ های مربوط به توسعه سیستم ها و ارتقاء ظرفیت.
ارتباط موثر با اعضای تیم و Stakeholders به صورت شفاهی و کتبی غرض بهبود امور و سیستم های موجود وزارت مالیه.
بهینه سازی عملکرد، مقیاس پذیری و کارایی نرم افزار از طریق پروفایل کد، کش کردن و سایر تکنیک های مرتبط.
نگهداری اسناد فنی جامع، از جمله معماری سیستم، مشخصات طراحی و راهنمای کاربر
بررسی کد ها و حصول اطمینان از کیفیت، امنیت و قابلیت نگهداری کد و داشتن سهم فعال در فرآیند تضمین کیفیت .
وظایف مدیریتی:
تهیه و ترتیب پلان کاری ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه در مطابقت با پلان عمومی اداره، جهت بدست آوردن اهداف تعیین شده.
ارایه گزارش ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه و عندالضرورت از فعالیت ها و دست آورد های بخش مربوطه، به منظور مطلع ساختن رهبری اداره.
اجرای سایر وظایف که از طرف مقامات ذیصلاح مطابق قوانین، مقررات و اهداف اداره سپرده میشود.
وظایف همآهنگی:
تامین هماهنگی بین آمریت های مرتبط بخش های اداره و خارج از اداره پیرامون موضوعات.
شریک نمودن نظریات و ارایه مشوره در حصه بهبود سیستم ها، روند کاری، ارتقای ظرفیت و غیره موارد با مدیریت بخش مربوطه.
شرایط استخدام:
تابعیت افغانستان را داشته باشد.
سن وی از (18) سال کمتر و از (64) سال بیشتر نباشد.
سویه تحصیلی :
داشتن سند تحصیلی حداقل لیسانس در یکی از رشته های ( کمپیوترساینس، سیستم های معلوماتی و انجنیری نرم افزار ) داخل یا خارج کشور که به تائید وزارت تحصیلات عالی رسیده باشد.
تجربه کاری:
حداقل دو سال مرتبط به وظیفه.
مهارت های لازم :
قابلیت طرح و تعین خط مشی (پالیسی ) اداره/ وزارت مربوطه.
تسلط به یکی از زبان ‌های رسمی ملی (پشتو یا دری) و آشنایی با زبان انگلیسی؛
مهارت ‌های کمپیوتری در برنامه ‌های مرتبط به وظیفه مربوطه.
بلدیت با تکنالوژی های ویب، فریم ورک ها و کتابخانه ها، مانند:
JavaScript, React, Next.js, Version control systems, and Agile methodology
مهارت تحلیل نیازمندی ها، حل مساله ها و کارتیمی.
بلدیت با دیتابیس های SQL , NoSQL
بلدیت با SDLC و Main software Engineering principles
بلدیت به زبان های برنامه نویسی، مانند: Java, Python, PHP, C#

Submission Guideline
علاقمندان واجد شرایط می توانند که سی وی و درخواستی خویش را در یک فایل پی دی اف به ایمیل ادرس ذیل ارسال نمایند
نوت: لطف نموده درعنوان ایمیل خود نام بست و یا کود نمبر آنرا بنویسید ضم کردن اسناد تحصیلی، تجارب کاری و غیره فعلاً

نصب، عیارسازی، پیکربندی و نگهداری تجهیزات شبکه Cisco Router, Switches, Firewall.
طرح و تطبیق پالیسی‌های امنیتی جهت محافظت از شبکه در برابر تهدیدات داخلی و خارجی و دسترسی‌های غیرمجاز

تدویر برنامه‌های آموزشی برای کارمندان جهت استفاده صحیح و مؤثر از تجهیزات و خدمات تکنالوژی معلوماتی .
ترتیب پروپوزل‌ها و مشخصات تخنیکی معیاری برای پروژه‌های توسعه و ارتقای تکنالوژی معلوماتی در مرکز و ولایات .

title: 284 - کارشناس ارشد سیستم و مجازی سازی
location: Kabul - ریاست سیستم های مالی افغانستان
description:
Job Summary
هدف وظیفه: کمک با ادارات و مسؤلین امارتی در مورد عملیات های فنی سیستم معلوماتی مالی امارت جهت حل مشکلات تخنیکی

Job Requirements
وظایف و مسئولیت ها:
وظایف تخصصی:
نصب، پیکربندی و نگهداری سیستم‌عامل‌ها ( Windows Server ، Linux )
مدیریت Active Directory ، DNS ، DHCP ، Group Policy
مدیریت کاربران، دسترسی‌ها و سطح امنیت
مانیتورینگ عملکرد سرورها و رفع مشکلات ( Troubleshooting )
پیاده‌سازی و مدیریت Backup و Restore و مدیریت Storage و File Server
طراحی و پیاده‌سازی زیرساخت مجازی‌سازی ( VMware ESXi, Vcenter ، Hyper-V )
ساخت، تنظیم و مدیریت Virtual Machines (VMs) .
مدیریت Resource ها ( CPU ، RAM ، Storage ).
پیاده‌سازی High Availability (HA) و Failover .
مانیتورینگ زیرساخت مجازی‌سازی .
تطبیق به ‌روزرسانی ‌ها و وصله‌های امنیتی (Security Patches) برای سیستم‌عامل‌ها، نرم‌افزارهای زیرساختی و پلتفرم‌های مجازی‌سازی، مطابق با طرزالعمل‌های تأییدشده .
طراحی و تطبیق راهکارهای افزونگی (Redundancy) و تحمل خطا (Fault Tolerance) برای کاهش خطر توقف خدمات و افزایش پایداری زیرساخت .
تشخیص و رفع مشکلات پیچیده سیستم‌عامل‌ها، سرویس‌های زیرساختی، ماشین‌های مجازی و منابع ذخیره‌سازی، با استفاده از ابزارهای تشخیصی و تحلیل لاگ‌ها .
مدیریت امنیت Active Directory و Domain Controllers: تطبیق تنظیمات امنیتی برای Active Directory ، Domain Controllers ، Group Policy و حساب‌های کاربری؛ شناسایی و رفع تنظیمات نادرست، حساب‌های غیرفعال، مجوزهای غیرضروری و ضعف‌های امنیتی مرتبط با احراز هویت و مدیریت هوی
تأمین امنیت پلتفرم‌های مجازی‌سازی: تطبیق تنظیمات امنیتی در VMware ESXi ، vCenter و Hyper-V ، محدودسازی دسترسی مدیریتی، جداسازی شبکه‌های مدیریتی، محافظت از رابط‌های مدیریتی و بررسی دوره‌ای تنظیمات امنیتی مطابق با معیارهای تأییدشده .
مدیریت امنیت لاگ‌ها و ثبت رویدادها ( Logging and Auditing): فعال‌سازی و تنظیم ثبت رویدادهای امنیتی در سیستم‌عامل‌ها، Active Directory ، سرورها و پلتفرم‌های مجازی‌سازی؛ تأمین نگهداری امن لاگ‌ها، جلوگیری از دست‌کاری غیرمجاز.
مدیریت امنیت حساب‌های خدماتی و ارتباطات سیستمی ( Service Accounts): شناسایی و مستندسازی حساب‌های خدماتی، محدودسازی امتیازات آن‌ها، جلوگیری از استفاده غیرضروری از حساب‌های دارای دسترسی ممتاز، مدیریت امن رمزهای عبور و بررسی دوره‌ای مجوزها و فعالیت‌های این حساب‌ها.

تهیه و ترتیب پلان کاری ماهوار، ربعوار و سالانه در مطابقت با پلان عمومی ریاست عمومی خزاین ، بمنظور رسیدن به اهداف ت عیین شده اداره.

title: Senior MEAL Associate
description:
Job Description
Under the overall supervision of the Chief of Mission (CoM), Programme Support Unit Coordinator and the direct supervision of the M&E officer the successful candidate will be responsible for providing technical support and coordinating the implementation monitoring and evaluation activities across different program.
Responsibilities
Plan for and support the undertaking of PDM and any other M&E data collection exercises; periodically review the project M&E monitoring tools and plans to guide M&E activities.
With guidance from the M&E Officer, coordinate the development, testing, roll out and regular revision of standardized M&E and reporting tools, within the program strategy and donor’s requirements, respecting formats, deadlines, and specific protocols, and engaging in crossed fertilization of ideas implementing partners.
Coordinate the process for identifying the key performance questions, indicators and parameters for all project development, monitoring projects’ performance and achievements,
Monitor ongoing activities of the programme; periodically and consistently aggregate and analyse data on respective projects’ indicators and develop indicator (IPTT) status reports and statistics to inform project management of progress of results achievement and for other purposes such as periodic and final reports, project visibility and communications; and
Coordinate the consolidation of monthly M&E report and Track unit workplan implementation of respective projects and support the production of regular monitoring reports. Prepare a trend analysis report from out PDM and other datas
Carry out periodic field visits using appropriate M&E tools to monitor the activities, beneficiaries and promote adherence to agreed M&E standards and norms; undertake M&E data quality assurance and data verification; identify bottlenecks impeding project delivery and gather feedback about IOM’s work among others.
Provide technical recommendations to the Project Manager, based on rolling analysis of and reporting on programming.
Perform other duties as assigned.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications and Experience
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Development, Economics, Management and, or related Social or Political Science fields from an accredited academic institution with 5 years of relevant experience; or
School diploma with seven years of relevant professional experience
Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database.
Experience
Minimum of seven years ( five years for degree holders) relevant experience in monitoring and evaluation of programmes related to migration management, particularly counter human trafficking, return and reintegration, direct assistance to vulnerable migrants including victims of trafficking.
Skills
Demonstrated experience in monitoring and evaluation – with specific experience in project development, data analysis, knowledge management, monitoring, and evaluation in the non-profit sector;
Demonstrated proficiency with MS office and advanced data science and/or statistical skills including knowledge of database management, statistical and project management software and data visualization skills is a strong advantage;
Excellent data visualization, analysis and writing skills
Proven ability to establish and maintain strong working relations with relevant Government counterparts, international organizations, and private sector entities.
Note: Strong preference for female candidates .
Languages
For all Applicants, fluency in English is required (oral and written).
Working knowledge of Pashto or Dari is required.
Fluency in all national language(s) are highly advantages.
Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments.
Required Competencies
IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process.
Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values:
Inclusion and respect for diversity : Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion.
Integrity and transparency : Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct.
Professionalism : Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges.
Courage : Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance.
Empathy : Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated.
Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2
Teamwork : Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results.
Delivering results : Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes.
Managing and sharing knowledge : Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate.
Accountability : Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work.
Communication : Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way.
Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2, if with direct reports
Leadership : Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential.
Empowering others : Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential.
Building Trust : Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty.
Strategic thinking and vision : Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction.
Humility : Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings.
Notes
Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category.
Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation.
This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months.
Appointment will be subject to certification that the candidate is medically fit for appointment, accreditation, any residency or visa requirements, security clearances.
IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and discrimination based on gender, nationality, age, race, sexual orientation, religious or ethnic background or disabilities.
IOM does not charge a fee at any stage of its recruitment process (application, interview, processing, training or other fee). IOM does not request any information related to bank accounts.
IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM e-Recruitment system (for internal candidates link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application.
No late applications will be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies

location: Kabul - ریاست سیستم های مالی افغانستان
description:
Job Summary
هدف وظیفه:
طراحی و توسعه سیستم‌ های نرم ‌افزاری مالی به منظور افزایش کارایی سیستم ها، ایجاد راهکارهای تخنیکی معیاری، پایدار و قابل اعتماد برای حمایت از فعالیت ‌های مالی اداره.

Job Requirements
صلاحیت و مسئولیت های وظیفوی:
وظایف تخصصی:
طراحی، انکشاف و توسعه سیستم ‌ها و اپلیکیشن ‌های نرم افزاری جدید مطابق نیازمندی ‌های اداره.
طراحی ساختار و اجزای تخنیکی نرم‌ افزار مطابق معیارهای توسعه
برنامه ‌نویسی و نوشتن کُدهای معیاری برای انکشاف و توسعه سیستم‌ها با استفاده از زبان‌هایی مانند C# ، .NET Core ، Java و تکنالوژی‌های مرتبط.
طراحی و توسعه رابط‌های برنامه ‌نویسی ( API ) برای اتصال سیستم‌ ها و سرویس‌های داخلی و خارجی.
تحلیل نیازمندی ‌های تخنیکی و تجارتی سیستم ‌ها و ارائه راهکارهای نرم ‌افزاری قابل تطبیق.
انجام آزمایشات نرم ‌افزاری جهت اطمینان از کیفیت و کارکرد درست سیستم‌ ها.
تهیه، به ‌روزرسانی و نگهداری اسناد تخنیکی سیستم‌ ها.
رعایت و تطبیق معیارها، رهنمود ها و بهترین شیوه‌ های توسعه نرم‌ افزار در تمام مراحل انکشاف سیستم.
تشخیص و رفع مشکلات تخنیکی سیستم ‌ها در جریان توسعه و بهره برداری.
همکاری تخنیکی با اعضای تیم توسعه، طراحان و تیم تطبیق در جریان پیاده‌ سازی سیستم ‌ها.
اشتراک در بازبینی کُدها ( Code Review ) و ارائه پیشنهادات تخنیکی جهت بهبود کیفیت توسعه.
همکاری تخنیکی با تیم ‌های تحلیل، تطبیق و نگهداری سیستم‌ ها .
انتقال مهارت ‌ها و تجارب تخنیکی به همکاران در جریان کار .
انجام سایر وظایف مرتبط با توسعه نرم ‌افزار مطابق هدایت آمر مربوطه .
وظایف مدیریتی:
رهنمایی تخنیکی تیم توسعه در خصوص معیارهای کد نویسی و طراحی سیستم ‌ها.
ارزیابی کیفیت کارهای تخنیکی انجام‌ شده در چارچوب پروژه ‌ها.
ترتیب و ارائه گزارش‌های تخنیکی و پیشرفت کار به آمر مربوطه.
وظایف هماهنگی:
هماهنگی با تیم ‌های تحلیل، تطبیق و نگهداری سیستم ‌ها.
تأمین هماهنگی با ادارات ذیربط در جریان انکشاف سیستم ‌های مالی به‌ منظور جلوگیری از نادرستی در درک پروسه ‌ها .
همکاری با کاربران و ذیربطین در رفع مشکلات تخنیکی سیستم‌ ها.

title: General Manager (ISP)

Mawj Faza is seeking a highly motivated and experienced General Manager to lead and oversee the company’s daily operations, business growth, and strategic development. The ideal candidate should have strong leadership skills and solid experience in the Internet Service Provider (ISP) industry.

Duties and Responsibilities
* Lead and manage all company operations.

* Prepare operational and management reports for company leadership.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
* Identify new business opportunities and expand market share.

Job Requirements
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related field (Master’s degree is an advantage).

* Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
* Customer-focused mindset with excellent organizational skills.

* Performance-based incentives.
* Professional development opportunities.
* Supportive and dynamic working environment.

Submission Guidelines
Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV along with a cover letter.
Email: mawjfaza@gmail.com
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Senior IT Security Officer
description:
Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior IT Security Officer to join our team and oversee the protection and security of our organization's IT infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be responsible for driving efforts to prevent, monitor, and respond to information/data breaches and cyber-attacks, ensuring the execution of Information Security directives and activities in alignment with the company's data security policy.

Duties and Responsibilities
1. Design, update, and enforce enterprise-wide security policies, standards, and procedures aligned with industry frameworks and Organization’s security policies.
2. Coordinate security awareness programs and train employees on cybersecurity best practices, threat recognition and ensure compliance with security regulations and standards.
3. Oversee the execution of comprehensive security assessments and compliance audits to proactively identify vulnerabilities and recommend security enhancements.
4. Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, security audits, and risk analyses to identify gaps and implement effective mitigation strategies.
5. Ensure security incidents are managed and forensic investigations are executed when necessary.
6. Cross-functional collaboration is maintained to systematically address emerging security concerns and implement security best practices.
7. Lead the detection, investigation, and response efforts for security breaches, cyberattacks, or system anomalies
8. Provide strategic guidance and recommendations to enhance the organization's overall security posture.
9. A comprehensive understanding of current security trends, advanced threat, and emerging technologies is maintained to ensure potential systemic risks are proactively mitigated.
10. Develop and maintain security incident response plans and procedures.
11. Lead and mentor a team of security professionals to ensure effective execution of security initiatives.
12. Act as a technical liaison to upper management, legal teams, and external auditors to ensure regulatory and data privacy compliance.
13. Ensure compliance with industry regulations, standards, and best practices.
14. Supervise and maintain security systems, including firewalls, SIEM platforms, and endpoint protection tools.

Job Requirements

· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

description:

About Us
Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Job Brief
We are expanding our focus to cover AI-augmented threat intelligence and post-quantum cryptographic (PQC) security. The ideal candidate will combine deep blockchain forensics expertise with working knowledge of machine learning techniques for anomaly detection, and awareness of quantum computing threats to current cryptographic foundations (ECDSA, RSA) used across blockchain ecosystems. We value candidates who can bridge academia and industry and build collaborative relationships with research institutions to accelerate the adoption of emerging cryptographic and AI-driven techniques within the company.
Main Responsibilities of a Blockchain Risk Control Analyst/Researcher
Your main responsibilities will include:
Leveraging LLM techniques to drive the development of next-generation on-chain risk identification and threat intelligence systems, including autonomous agent workflows capable of continuous monitoring, self-triggered investigation, and automated operational responses — reducing manual intervention across the full risk lifecycle from detection to resolution;
Leading forensic investigations on real crypto theft, fraud, and market manipulation cases, integrating AI-assisted pattern recognition to accelerate root cause analysis;
Researching post-quantum cryptographic algorithms (NIST PQC: ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and their implications for blockchain security; assessing quantum computing threats to existing cryptographic foundations (ECDSA secp256k1, hash functions) and evaluating migration paths;
Partnering with internal teams and external stakeholders for incident response, and engaging with academic institutions to translate frontier research into deployable security tools;
Key Requirements
You have a Master's or PhD's degree in Blockchain security, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
You are good at programming languages commonly used in blockchain analytics (e.g., SQL, Python, Javascript)
Experience applying machine learning or AI techniques to blockchain data analysis, fraud detection, or threat intelligence
A strong publication record in top-level industry or academic conferences is highly valued.
You have experience with blockchain monitoring/forensic tools and analytics platforms.
Familiarity with NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FALCON) and lattice/hash-based cryptography fundamentals is a plus;
Understanding of quantum computing threats to elliptic curve cryptography and implications for key management in Web3;
You have security or risk control experience as a plus.
You possess effective communication and collaboration abilities.
English is essential, and proficiency in Mandarin can be an advantage.

Job Summary
Ramaki Group of Companies is seeking a qualified Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to define and execute the technology vision, strategy, and roadmap for its digital products and platforms. The role focuses on strategic leadership, secure and scalable infrastructure, regulatory compliance, and building a high-performing engineering team, all aligned with organizational business goals, customer needs, and industry standards.
The CTO will own the end-to-end technology function for Ramaki's fintech operations, from strategic planning and team development to vendor management and system reliability. • Define the technology vision, strategy, and roadmap in line with business goals.

Cybersecurity and Infrastructure
• Oversee the security approach and make sure security is built into the platform.

• Ensure the platform is reliable, scalable and available, with accurate transaction processing, clear SLAs and monitoring.

title: MSP Mac Help Desk Guru (work from home)
description:
Headquarters: ignitionit.com
URL: https://ignitionit.com
Fully Remote · Work from home · Full-time (Eastern or Pacific time zones) · Apple-first
TL;DR
ignitionit.com is a seasoned, Apple-first MSP — in business for almost 30 years — and we're hiring a Help Desk Technician to be the friendly, capable first voice our clients reach when something isn't working. This position is a remote, work-from-home, full-time role.
We've written this as a junior-to-mid-level job description because that's where most great people start on our team. But if you're more seasoned — comfortable in identity, MDM, or security work — don't scroll past. We'd be delighted to find someone who can step in higher up the ladder, and we'll happily talk about a more senior scope and comp if that's you.
What the actual job???
Unlike many IT shops, we believe that the technology is the tactic. The actual job is making people feel taken care of. One of our core values is “49% tech support, 51% human support.”
You'll succeed by configuring devices, resetting access, untangling email, and chasing down the gremlin that's been haunting someone's conference room. But you'll know you succeeded when a client exhales and says, “Thank goodness you're on it!” That Warm Fuzzy Feeling™ is the actual product. The green lights on the dashboard are just how we get there.
In a typical week, you might:
Onboard a new hire at a fast-growing startup: provision their Mac, set up their Google Workspace or Microsoft 365 accounts, enroll the device in MDM, and make sure day one feels effortless.
Offboard a departing employee cleanly — recover the laptop, revoke access, and close the loop so nothing's left dangling. All boxes checked, ticket notated and closed, client followed up with.
Field a "my email stopped working" ticket that turns out to be a DNS thing, a phishing-filter thing, or a "they changed their password on their phone three weeks ago" thing.
Help a family office or RIA get a touchy Zoom Room or conference-room AV setup behaving before a meeting — over the phone.
Triage the queue so phones get answered fast, emails don't rot, and nobody feels forgotten — even when the honest answer is, “We're on it, but here's the realistic timeline."
⠀ You'll be the front line: helping with what you can, researching what you can't, and pinging the rest of the team when you're genuinely stuck. That last part is a skill, not a weakness — knowing when to ask is half the job.
About ignitionit.com
We're one of the oldest Apple Technical Partners on the planet, and one of the only certified Apple Premier Partners — that’s kinda like getting knighted by the ghost of Steve Jobs. We started where you’d expect to find Macs (creative agencies, non-profits, education) but our primary clients today are cutting-edge, venture-backed AI SaaS startups, VC and private equity firms, registered investment advisors — many of them operating under stringent compliance expectations (SOC 2, SEC). That means we hold ourselves to a higher standard than the scrappy shop we started as. Polished, reliable, security-minded work is the baseline now — but always with a smile!
What hasn't changed: relationships are still our most valuable currency — with clients, with vendors, and with each other. We're a tight, supportive team. We teach each other what we know, cover for each other when life throws a punch, and care a little too much about doing things the right way. We're still a bit weird, and our clients seem to like us that way.
We move fast, priorities shift, it’s not always documented (whatever it is), our tool set and list of supported platforms is sprawling, and some days the to-do list is longer than you'd like. If you can stay warm under pressure, create order out of chaos, learn new stuff fast because you love it, and speak up when you need help, you'll thrive here.

About ZoomInfo
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute, you’ll make things happen, fast.
The Opportunity
ZoomInfo’s Core Data team builds the company and contact data behind the Go-To-Market Intelligence Platform: hundreds of millions of records, resolved to the right entity, kept accurate, and delivered to more than 35,000 customers.
The way that data is produced is changing. For years it came from deterministic pipelines: many sources, weighted and decayed, one winner per attribute. Core Data is now moving to AI-native data management, where an agent pursues the evidence for an entity, decides every attribute over all of it, and records why. The company and contact agents already exist as working, measured prototypes. What does not exist yet is the machinery that runs them at production volume, proves every version before it ships, and lets researchers and product managers operate them without an engineer in the loop.
We are hiring a Senior Applied AI Engineer to build and own that machinery. You will complete the entity-agent pipeline, build the evidence adapters behind a single envelope, run the benchmark and golden-gate system on a schedule, build the review and batch tooling the team operates, and carry the agents onto ZoomInfo’s Agentic Platform. You will work with the Principal AI Engineer who owns the benchmark harness and productionization, the product manager who owns evaluation and policy, and the company and person engineering teams that own the pipelines the agents feed. You will not be the only person who can do this work; you will be the second, so that neither of you is a single point of failure.
This is a role for someone who has shipped LLM systems in production with evaluations, builds platform for other people to operate, and can work inside a large-scale data pipeline. You should be as comfortable writing an adapter with a replayable store and a kill switch as you are reading a miss analysis with a product manager, and you should like that the prototype you take to production was built by a PM who commits code.
What You’ll Do
Run the benchmark and golden-gate system. Move judge runs, golden-gate results, arms scorecards, and cost per record from a laptop to a scheduled system against staging. Every agent version is gated automatically, with variance and drift tracked per release. The evaluation product manager sets the thresholds; you make them enforceable.
Complete the entity-agent pipeline. Build the stages that do not exist yet: enricher fan-out, location sets, and hierarchy batch files. Migrate the classifiers to the shared runner with the Principal AI Engineer so they run at production scale. Measure throughput and unit cost per stage on named cohorts, so the cost model comes from instrumentation rather than estimates.
Build the evidence adapters. Registries, live web, mail-tenant signals, and external research vendors all sit behind one envelope with a replayable vendor store, measured lift per shape, a per-vendor kill switch, and at least two sources per shape. Vendors are swappable by design.

title: IT Officer – MIS System Support
category: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology
description:
Role Summary
The IT Officer – MIS System Support will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, maintenance, security, and operational support of the Aurum MFI MIS system. The successful candidate will serve as the dedicated technical focal point for the system, ensuring its availability, data integrity, proper user access management, timely backups, and effective coordination with relevant departments, software developers, and external technical support providers.

Duties and Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities
1. MIS System Administration
Manage and monitor the day-to-day operation of the Aurum MFI MIS system.
Create, configure, update, suspend, and deactivate user accounts based on authorized requests.
Assign and manage user roles and access permissions in accordance with approved policies.
Maintain system configurations, operational settings, and user access records.
Monitor system performance and report technical issues, errors, or operational disruptions.
2. Data Backup and Recovery
Perform and monitor regular backups of the MIS database and related system data.
Verify backup completion and periodically test data restoration procedures.
Maintain backup logs and ensure backups are stored securely in accordance with the approved backup policy.
Coordinate with the relevant technical team to resolve backup failures and support data recovery when required.
Help ensure data integrity, availability, and business continuity.
3. Technical Support and Troubleshooting
Provide first-level technical support to MIS users and resolve routine system-related issues.
Investigate system errors, access problems, data discrepancies, and performance issues.
Document incidents, follow up on unresolved issues, and escalate complex technical problems to the relevant developers or service providers.
Coordinate system troubleshooting, bug fixes, upgrades, patches, and technical improvements.
Support system testing and verification before changes are implemented in the production environment.
4. System Maintenance and Security
Coordinate routine system maintenance and monitor system availability.
Ensure that user access is properly authorized and reviewed periodically.
Follow approved information security, data protection, and access control procedures.
Maintain technical documentation, system configuration records, backup logs, and incident reports.
Identify potential operational and security risks and report them to the relevant team.
5. Technical and Departmental Coordination
Act as the primary IT focal point for MIS-related matters.
Coordinate with the Microfinance Operations team, Finance, relevant business units, software developers, and external technical support providers.
Follow up on reported issues, requested changes, system enhancements, and pending technical tasks.
Assist in gathering business requirements and communicating them to the technical team.
6. Reporting and User Support
Prepare periodic reports on system availability, incidents, backup status, user administration, and maintenance activities.
Maintain an updated record of users, permissions, technical issues, and system changes.
Guide and assist staff in using the MIS system correctly and securely.
Provide basic user training and prepare user guides or operational instructions when necessary.
Perform other relevant IT and MIS support duties assigned by the IT Manager.

Job Requirements
Qualifications and Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in IT support, MIS support or a similar position.
Experience supporting a Management Information System (MIS), preferably in microfinance, banking, financial services, or another regulated organization.
Understanding of user administration, role-based access control, system security, and data protection.
Familiarity with web-based applications, application troubleshooting, and software maintenance.
Good documentation, reporting, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Strong communication and coordination skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical teams.
Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and maintain confidentiality when handling financial and customer data.
Key Competencies
Technical troubleshooting and analytical thinking.
Accuracy and attention to detail.
Accountability and ownership of assigned responsibilities.
Effective communication and teamwork.
Confidentiality and professional integrity.
Proactive monitoring and timely reporting of technical issues.

Submission Guidelines
How to Apply:
Interested and qualified candidates are invited to submit their CV and cover letter (in PDF format) to jobs@aurumaf.com
Please mention the position title “ IT Officer – MIS System Support ” in the subject line of your email.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview

description:
Job Summary
Position Summary: Ariana Medical Complex invites qualified individual IT professionals and eligible IT companies or service providers to apply for the management and support of the hospital’s information technology systems.
The selected individual or service provider will be responsible for planning, managing, maintaining, securing, and improving the hospital’s IT infrastructure and services. These services must support the hospital’s clinical, administrative, financial, and operational activities while ensuring system reliability, information security, confidentiality of patient data, and continuity of essential hospital services.
Applicants may apply under one of the following categories:
Category A – Individual IT Manager: An experienced IT professional responsible for managing the hospital’s IT operations and supervising the hospital’s IT staff.
Category B – IT Company / Service Provider: A qualified company that provides IT management services through a designated IT manager and an appropriately skilled technical team under an agreement with the hospital.
Key Responsibilities:
A. Strategic Leadership and IT Governance
Develop and implement an IT strategy aligned with the hospital’s objectives and healthcare service requirements.
Establish, review, and maintain IT policies, procedures, technical standards, and operational controls.
Advise hospital management on technology investments, digital transformation, system improvements, and IT-related risks.
Develop an annual IT work plan, including priorities, resource requirements, maintenance schedules, and improvement activities.
Ensure IT operations support the hospital’s clinical, administrative, financial, and operational departments.
B. IT Operations and Infrastructure
Manage and maintain servers, computer networks, databases, applications, workstations, printers, scanners, switches, cameras, and related equipment.
Ensure the availability, performance, reliability, and proper functioning of critical hospital IT systems.
Manage network architecture, routing, connectivity, wireless networks, internet services, email systems, and internal communications.
Coordinate installation, configuration, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of IT equipment.
Maintain an updated inventory of IT equipment, software, licenses, systems, and related assets.
Minimize service interruptions and coordinate timely resolution of technical problems.
C. Information Security and Data Protection
Protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of hospital information and patient records.
Implement appropriate access controls, user account management, password policies, endpoint protection, and security monitoring.
Establish and maintain regular data backup, restoration testing, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures.
Monitor and address cybersecurity risks, vulnerabilities, unauthorized access, malware, and other security incidents.
Ensure that access to patient information is restricted to authorized personnel and permitted purposes.
Report significant security incidents promptly to the designated hospital authority.
Ensure that hospital data is not copied, transferred, disclosed, or used without proper authorization.
D. Systems Development and Improvement
Assess, recommend, install, configure, and maintain suitable hardware, software, and technology solutions.
Support the effective operation and improvement of hospital information systems, including clinical, administrative, financial, and other approved platforms.
Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend cost-effective solutions that improve hospital services.
Coordinate system upgrades, software updates, equipment replacement, and technical projects.
Ensure that changes to critical systems are properly authorized, documented, tested, and implemented.
E. IT Support and Team Management
Provide or coordinate timely technical support to all hospital departments.
Supervise, guide, and evaluate hospital IT staff, where applicable.
Ensure proper allocation of IT duties, technical coverage, staff development, and performance monitoring.
Establish a system for receiving, recording, prioritizing, tracking, and resolving IT support requests.
Provide advanced technical assistance for complex IT and system-related issues.
Maintain appropriate technical coverage for critical hospital services, including agreed arrangements for urgent and after-hours support.
F. Budget, Procurement, and Vendor Management
Prepare or contribute to the annual IT budget, equipment replacement plan, and maintenance requirements.
Recommend cost-effective procurement of IT equipment, software, licenses, and technical services.
Coordinate with authorized hospital departments regarding procurement specifications, vendor evaluation, and technical acceptance.
Manage technical relationships with internet providers, software vendors, equipment suppliers, and other service providers.
Monitor vendor performance, warranties, service agreements, licenses, and maintenance commitments.
Ensure that procurement and expenditure recommendations are submitted through the hospital’s approved authorization procedures.
G. Compliance, Documentation, and Reporting
Ensure compliance with hospital policies, applicable regulations, accreditation requirements, and approved information security procedures.
Maintain updated technical documentation, network diagrams, system configurations, equipment inventories, access records, and maintenance logs.
Prepare regular reports covering system availability, support requests, incidents, cybersecurity risks, completed activities, and proposed improvements.
Report major risks, service disruptions, resource gaps, and unresolved technical issues to the designated hospital authority.
Perform other relevant duties assigned by hospital leadership within the approved scope of work.
2. Confidentiality and Ownership of Hospital Information
The selected individual or company must:
Sign the required confidentiality and data protection undertaking before receiving access to hospital systems or information.
Use hospital data and systems solely for authorized purposes.
Maintain appropriate safeguards for patient information, employee records, financial information, and other confidential hospital data.
Refrain from retaining, disclosing, transferring, or using hospital information after termination of the engagement, except where expressly authorized or legally required.
Ensure that all hospital data, configurations, documentation, credentials, and other hospital-owned information remain under the hospital’s control.
Return hospital property and transfer all required records, documentation, credentials, and system access arrangements upon termination or completion of the assignment.
3. Deliverables and Performance Indicators
The selected individual or company will be expected to provide the following deliverables according to an agreed implementation schedule:

Assessment and prioritized action plan submitted and approved

Requests recorded, tracked, and handled within agreed service levels
5

Backups monitored and restoration tests documented
6

Access controls reviewed and security incidents reported

Complete handover completed at the end of the engagement
Specific uptime targets, response times, resolution targets, and other service-level indicators shall be agreed upon in the contract or service agreement, taking into account the hospital’s operational requirements and available resources.

Job Requirements
4. Additional Requirements for Individual Applicants
Individual applicants must meet the following minimum requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. A master’s degree is an advantage.
At least five years of progressively responsible IT experience, including at least two years in a supervisory or managerial role.
Experience in server administration, network management, cybersecurity, backup systems, disaster recovery, and IT support.
Experience managing enterprise-level infrastructure; experience in a hospital or other healthcare institution is an advantage.
Strong leadership, planning, troubleshooting, communication, and decision-making skills.
High professional integrity and commitment to confidentiality and data protection.
Fluency in Dari, Pashto, and English, with the ability to communicate effectively in the languages required for the assignment.
Ability to provide the services and meet the attendance, availability, and reporting requirements agreed with the hospital.
5. Additional Requirements for IT Companies / Service Providers
Companies applying for this assignment must provide evidence of their ability to deliver reliable IT management services in a hospital environment.
Minimum requirements include:
Valid business registration and authorization to provide IT-related services under applicable Afghan laws and regulations.
Demonstrated experience in IT infrastructure management, technical support, networking, cybersecurity, systems maintenance, or related services.
A company profile describing its technical capabilities, service coverage, organizational structure, and relevant experience.
Evidence of previous relevant assignments, including client references or completion certificates where available.
A proposed service delivery team, including a designated IT Manager or Team Leader and appropriately qualified technical personnel.
CVs, educational qualifications, and relevant experience records for key personnel assigned to the hospital.
A technical proposal explaining the proposed management approach, service delivery arrangements, support coverage, escalation procedures, backup strategy, cybersecurity measures, and reporting arrangements.
A proposed service-level arrangement specifying response times, resolution targets, system monitoring, preventive maintenance, and emergency support.
A financial proposal detailing professional fees, staffing costs, maintenance charges, and any additional costs, clearly identifying applicable exclusions.
Written acceptance of the hospital’s confidentiality, patient data protection, access control, and information security requirements.
The company shall nominate a qualified person to serve as its primary contact and IT Manager for the assignment. Replacement of key personnel must be subject to prior approval by the hospital.
6. Evaluation and Selection Criteria
Applications will be evaluated according to the applicant category.
For individual applicants:
Educational qualifications and relevant certifications.
Years and relevance of IT management experience.
Technical competence and problem-solving ability.
Leadership and communication skills.
Healthcare or comparable enterprise IT experience.
Proposed approach to managing the hospital’s IT operations.
For companies / service providers:
Legal registration and eligibility.
Relevant company experience and past performance.
Qualifications and experience of the proposed IT Manager and technical team.
Technical proposal and service delivery methodology.
Availability, support coverage, cybersecurity, and continuity arrangements.
Financial proposal and overall value for money.
Ariana Medical Complex reserves the right to verify submitted documents, contact references, conduct interviews or technical assessments, request clarification, and select the applicant that best meets the hospital’s requirements, subject to its approved procedures.
7. Contractual and Administrative Arrangements
Individual applicants, if selected, shall enter into an employment or individual service contract, as determined by the hospital.
Companies, if selected, shall enter into a service agreement defining the scope of services, deliverables, staffing arrangements, service levels, payment terms, confidentiality obligations, performance monitoring, and termination conditions.
The final scope, contract duration, payment structure, working arrangements, and reporting requirements shall be agreed upon and approved by the hospital before commencement.
No applicant may access hospital systems or patient information before the required authorization and confidentiality arrangements are in place.
The hospital retains authority over strategic decisions, procurement approvals, system access authorization, and other reserved management functions.

Submission Guideline
8. Application Procedure
Interested individuals and eligible companies may submit their applications quoting the Job tile and the Vacancy Announcement Number (AMC | HRD-897) in the subject line to email.
Individual applicants should submit:
Updated CV.
Application letter.
Copies of educational certificates and relevant professional certifications.
Evidence of relevant work experience.
A brief technical approach to managing hospital IT services.
Fluency in English, Dari, and Pashto (spoken and written).
Companies / service providers should submit:
Company profile and valid registration documents.
Technical proposal and service delivery methodology.
Relevant contracts, references, or evidence of previous assignments.
CVs and qualifications of the proposed IT Manager and key technical personnel.
Proposed service-level arrangements and support coverage.
Detailed financial proposal.
Applications that do not include the required documents by November 30, 2026 or fail to mention the Vacancy Announcement Number and Job Title in the subject line will not be considered.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Job Summary
A. Backend Development & Microservices
· Design, develop, maintain, and optimize backend services and REST APIs using C# and ASP.NET Core / .NET Core.
· Design services using microservice architecture, clear service boundaries, maintainable domain/application layers, and clean architecture principles.
· Implement authentication, authorization, role/permission management, API validation, error handling, background processing, and secure service-to-service communication.

· Integrate MOAM systems with ERP (including Sage), CRM, payment gateways, SMS/notification services, Firebase, customs systems, and other internal or third-party platforms.

· Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs, authentication flows, real-time features, and server-side/client-side data fetching as appropriate.
· Build reusable UI components, handle application state effectively, and ensure performance, accessibility, maintainability, and cross-browser compatibility.
C. Mobile Application Development
· Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
· Integrate Flutter applications with .NET APIs and Firebase services such as Cloud Messaging/push notifications, authentication, analytics, or other required Firebase capabilities.

· Containerize applications and supporting services using Docker and Docker Compose; maintain reliable environment configuration across development, staging, and production.

· Monitor application and infrastructure health and diagnose production issues across services, containers, databases, logs, queues, caches, and network dependencies.

· Write unit and integration tests and perform API, frontend, and mobile validation before release.
· Apply secure coding practices for authentication, authorization, secrets, data protection, input validation, dependency management, and API security.
· Participate in technical design, sprint planning, backlog refinement, code reviews, Git workflows, troubleshooting, and documentation.
· Produce clear technical documentation for architecture, APIs, deployments, integrations, and operational procedures.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
Strong professional experience building full-stack production applications, with .NET Core / ASP.NET Core as the primary backend technology.
Hands-on experience with microservices, REST APIs, SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, Redis caching, RabbitMQ messaging, Serilog, and Seq.
Hands-on experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern frontend development practices.
Hands-on experience developing mobile applications with Flutter/Dart and integrating Firebase services.
Practical experience with Docker/containerization, Git, server administration, application deployment, and production troubleshooting.
Good understanding of software architecture, security, performance, scalability, concurrency, testing, and distributed-system fundamentals.
Ability to independently analyze technical problems, communicate clearly, document solutions, and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

CI/CD platforms, cloud or VPS environments, DNS/SSL management, backups, monitoring, and production incident response.

Ummat International Hospital is seeking a qualified, motivated, and responsible ICT and HMIS Officer to provide general information technology support and ensure the effective management, monitoring, and utilization of the hospital's Hospital Management Information System (HMIS).
The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting the hospital's IT infrastructure, computers, software, network connectivity, and other IT equipment. Provide routine technical support for computers, printers, scanners, and other IT equipment used within the hospital.
Troubleshoot basic hardware, software, operating system, and network connectivity issues.
Assist with the installation, configuration, and maintenance of authorized software and IT equipment.
Support internet connectivity and local area network (LAN) operations and coordinate with service providers to resolve major technical issues.
Assist hospital staff with common IT-related problems and provide basic guidance on the appropriate use of IT equipment and applications.
Maintain an inventory of IT equipment and keep records of technical issues, repairs, and maintenance activities.
Support the implementation of basic IT security practices, including antivirus updates, appropriate user access, and secure handling of digital information.
Assist with routine data backup and recovery procedures in coordination with the relevant technical personnel.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Role Summary
The Full Stack Developer is responsible for designing, developing, integrating, deploying, and supporting MOAM’s web, backend, and mobile applications. The role requires strong hands-on experience with .NET Core backend development and microservice architecture, Next.js frontend development, Flutter mobile development, and the infrastructure required to run these systems reliably in production.
The position will contribute to the design, development, and evolution of MOAM’s digital logistics ecosystem, including Courier and Cargo products across web and mobile platforms, shared backend services, system integrations, and future digital solutions, with responsibility spanning APIs, distributed services, caching, messaging, observability, databases, containerization, server administration, security, performance, and third-party integrations. The developer is expected to work across the complete software delivery lifecycle and collaborate closely with the Technology Unit and business stakeholders.

Duties and Responsibilities
A. Backend Development & Microservices
· Design, develop, maintain, and optimize backend services and REST APIs using C# and ASP.NET Core / .NET Core.
· Design services using microservice architecture, clear service boundaries, maintainable domain/application layers, and clean architecture principles.
· Implement authentication, authorization, role/permission management, API validation, error handling, background processing, and secure service-to-service communication.
· Work with SQL Server and relational data access using Entity Framework Core; design efficient schemas, migrations, indexes, transactions, and queries.
· Implement distributed caching and cache invalidation strategies using Redis or equivalent technologies.
· Use RabbitMQ for asynchronous messaging, event-driven workflows, queues, retries, and reliable communication between services; implement real-time application features using appropriate technologies such as SignalR/WebSockets where required.
· Integrate MOAM systems with ERP (including Sage), CRM, payment gateways, SMS/notification services, Firebase, customs systems, and other internal or third-party platforms.
B. Frontend Development
· Develop and maintain responsive, secure, production-ready web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
· Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs, authentication flows, real-time features, and server-side/client-side data fetching as appropriate.
· Build reusable UI components, handle application state effectively, and ensure performance, accessibility, maintainability, and cross-browser compatibility.
C. Mobile Application Development
· Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot cross-platform mobile applications using Flutter and Dart.
· Integrate Flutter applications with .NET APIs and Firebase services such as Cloud Messaging/push notifications, authentication, analytics, or other required Firebase capabilities.
· Manage mobile application state, API communication, error handling, local persistence, release builds, and application performance.
D. DevOps, Server & Deployment Management
· Containerize applications and supporting services using Docker and Docker Compose; maintain reliable environment configuration across development, staging, and production.
· Administer and troubleshoot application servers, preferably Linux-based environments, including services, networking, ports, SSL/TLS certificates, reverse proxies such as Nginx, storage, permissions, and resource usage.
· Support CI/CD pipelines, source control workflows, environment variables/secrets, deployment automation, backups, rollback procedures, and production releases.
· Monitor application and infrastructure health and diagnose production issues across services, containers, databases, logs, queues, caches, and network dependencies.
E. Logging, Monitoring & Reliability
· Implement structured application logging using Serilog and centralized log monitoring/analysis using Seq.
· Design meaningful logs, correlation identifiers, health checks, metrics, alerts, and diagnostics to support distributed systems and production troubleshooting.
· Improve application performance, scalability, resilience, fault handling, and availability through profiling, testing, and operational monitoring.
F. Quality, Security & Engineering Practices
· Write unit and integration tests and perform API, frontend, and mobile validation before release.
· Apply secure coding practices for authentication, authorization, secrets, data protection, input validation, dependency management, and API security.
· Participate in technical design, sprint planning, backlog refinement, code reviews, Git workflows, troubleshooting, and documentation.
· Produce clear technical documentation for architecture, APIs, deployments, integrations, and operational procedures.

Job Requirements
· Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a closely related field, or equivalent demonstrable professional experience.
· Strong professional experience building full-stack production applications, with .NET Core / ASP.NET Core as the primary backend technology.
· Hands-on experience with microservices, REST APIs, SQL Server, Entity Framework Core, Redis caching, RabbitMQ messaging, Serilog, and Seq.
· Hands-on experience with Next.js, React, TypeScript, and modern frontend development practices.
· Hands-on experience developing mobile applications with Flutter/Dart and integrating Firebase services.
· Practical experience with Docker/containerization, Git, server administration, application deployment, and production troubleshooting.
· Good understanding of software architecture, security, performance, scalability, concurrency, testing, and distributed-system fundamentals.
· Ability to independently analyze technical problems, communicate clearly, document solutions, and collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
· Good command of English for technical documentation and communication; Dari and/or Pashto are advantageous.
Preferred / Advantageous Experience
· API gateways/reverse proxies (for example YARP or Nginx), CQRS/Mediator patterns, background workers, scheduled jobs, and distributed tracing.
· CI/CD platforms, cloud or VPS environments, DNS/SSL management, backups, monitoring, and production incident response.
· Experience integrating ERP/CRM, logistics, warehouse, cargo, payment, notification, or other enterprise systems.
· Experience with Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman, automated testing, code quality tools, and Agile/Scrum delivery.

Submission Guidelines
Please send your CV and a brief cover letter to careers@moamlogistics.com . All documents should be submitted in PDF format , with the file name clearly indicating your first and last name and the position applied for . Please note that interviews may be conducted while the position remains open and under announcement .

description:
einleitung
Zur Verstärkung unseres Product Gameserver Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine:n Site Reliability Engineer (m/w/d ), der/die unseren Bereich aktiv mitgestaltet.
Als SRE (m/w/d) bist du Architekt:in und Verteidiger:in unserer Infrastruktur und sorgst für maximale Uptime, Performance und Stabilität – damit Millionen von Spieler:innen jederzeit ein reibungsloses Spielerlebnis genießen können.
deine aufgaben
Herrscher:in der Cluster: Du bist verantwortlich für den reibungslosen und hochverfügbaren Betrieb unserer Kubernetes-Cluster. Du skalierst, wartest und optimierst die Umgebung, in der unzählige Gaming-Abenteuer stattfinden.
Jäger:in der Latenz und Bugs: Du stellst den reibungslosen Betrieb unserer in Golang geschriebenen Kubernetes-Operatoren und anderer Services sicher. Performance-Optimierung und das Aufspüren von Fehlern sind für dich wie eine spannende Quest, um den Spieler:innen das bestmögliche Erlebnis zu garantieren.
Terraform-Architekt:in: Du entwirfst mit Terraform den Bauplan für unsere Infrastruktur. Du schaffst durch Infrastructure as Code (IaC) eine automatisierte und reproduzierbare Basis, auf der unsere Kundinnen und Kunden ihre eigenen digitalen Königreiche errichten können.
Ansible-Dompteur:in: Wiederkehrende manuelle Aufgaben sind deine Endgegner. Mit Ansible automatisiert du Konfigurationsmanagement, Deployments und alles andere, was dir im Weg steht, um eine stabile und konsistente Umgebung zu schaffen.
Wächter:in über die Performance: Du entwickelst und pflegst unsere Monitoring-, Logging- und Alerting-Systeme (z.B. mit Prometheus & Grafana), um Probleme zu erkennen, bevor sie zu einem "Game Over" führen.
dein profil
Kubernetes-Veteran: Du hast tiefgreifende, praxiserprobte Erfahrung im Betrieb, Management und Troubleshooting von Kubernetes-Clustern in einer Produktivumgebung.
Infrastructure as Code ist dein Credo: Du sprichst fließend Terraform und hast damit bereits komplexe Infrastrukturen aufgebaut und verwaltet.
Automatisierung im Blut: Du besitzt starke Kenntnisse in Ansible und nutzt es, um manuelle Prozesse zu eliminieren und die Effizienz zu steigern.
Ein Herz für Stabilität: Du denkst in Konzepten wie SLAs, SLOs und Error Budgets und hast eine Leidenschaft dafür, hochverfügbare und resiliente Systeme zu bauen.
Entwicklungserfahrung in Go : Du hast bereits Erfahrungen in der Entwicklung mit Go und liebst die Sprache für ihre Effizienz und Nebenläufigkeit. Du hast Kubernetes Operatoren in Go entwickelt und kannst bestehende in ihrer Laufzeit optimieren.
Gamer-Mindset: Du verstehst, was Spieler:innen von einer perfekten Plattform erwarten.
Kommunikationsstarker Teamplayer: Du schätzt den Austausch im Team, bringst dich aktiv ein und vermittelst komplexe technische Sachverhalte klar auf Englisch (Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus).
OnCall: Du nimmst an einer fair gestalteten Rufbereitschaft teil und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Zuverlässigkeit und Verfügbarkeit der Gameserver unserer Kunden.
Remote Setup : Du arbeitest remote innerhalb von +/- 2 Stunden zur Mitteleuropäischen Zeit (CET) und besitzt eine gültige EU-Arbeitserlaubnis (kein Relocation-Support). Über deine Teilnahme an unseren optionalen Teamtreffen (1x pro Quartal) freuen wir uns sehr!
deine benefits
Gaming im Herzen: Wir bieten kostenlose Nitrado Game Server für Gamer und eine einladende Community für alle, die sich wohlfühlen möchten, selbst wenn du kein/e Gamer:in bist. Entdecke, wie Nitrado mehr ist als nur Gaming - eine offene Community für Technologie und Kreativität.
Vertrauensarbeitszeit: Passe deine Arbeitszeiten an deine persönlichen Bedürfnisse an, um eine bessere Work-Life-Balance zu erreichen.
Remote Work: Unsere agilen Teams arbeiten Hand in Hand von ihrem bevorzugten Standort aus zusammen, sei es in unseren modernen Büros in Karlsruhe oder Berlin oder vollständig remote.
